races.race_name: Champagne Pommery Brut Rose Handicap

runners.name: Falcon Nine
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice at Ayr (1m2f, good to firm) last month, losing out only by a neck when clear of third on latter occasion; back in action before 3lb rise takes effect and remains 2lb lower than when winning this race a year ago; good chance.
runners.comment: 3lb well in after recent Ayr second and still 2lb lower than when winning this in 2025

runners.name: Toy Soldier
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on consecutive starts in Ireland (7f/7.4f) in June but made a low-key stable debut at Ayr (1m2f, good to firm) last month and still has stamina to prove over this sort of trip.
runners.comment: Second twice in Ireland in June (7f/7.4f) but made low-key stable debut last month (1m2f)

runners.name: Miners Gamble
runners.spotlight: Regressive 5yo with modest 1-27 strike-rate; seemed to have benefited from wind op when respectable fifth of 12 at Newcastle (1m, AW) last month but that race was slowly run and he needs to build on that performance; tongue-tie now added.
runners.comment: Ran okay last month, after a wind op, but overall profile not appealing

runners.name: Gemini Man
runners.spotlight: Won twice in June (1m2f/1m4f) and put two poor performances behind him when clear second here (1m5f, good) a week ago; can cope with this drop back in trip and is still on a workable mark; ought to make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Won twice in June, and put two poor runs behind him when clear second here last week

runners.name: Approaching Dawn
runners.spotlight: Won off basement mark here in June and doubled tally in Ayr classified (also 1m, good) last month; further progress is not out of the question but he has more on his plate today and was soundly beaten in recent Ayr handicap won by Samra Star.
runners.comment: Two wins this year; has more on his plate today, though, and was soundly beaten last week
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Liberty Looming
runners.spotlight: Weakened into sixth after racing too freely here (1m5f, good; Gemini Man second) a week ago and has now been unplaced all 19 starts (six times over hurdles); drops back in trip with cheekpieces refitted today.
runners.comment: Unplaced all 19 starts; drops back in trip with cheekpieces added today

runners.name: Samra Star
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to collar odds-on favourite and cause 25-1 surprise at Ayr (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago; only to due to go up 4lb for that but takes her chance under a 5lb penalty here and remains well handicapped on older form.
runners.comment: Collared odds-on favourite to cause 25-1 surprise at Ayr last week; 5lb penalty
runners.owner: The Hon Heather Galbraith & C Maxwell

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Faith In Florence
runners.spotlight: Built upon encouraging debut when close second at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago, where her tendency to hang left under pressure may have cost her the race; big player on these terms if coping with the drop in trip.
runners.comment: Went close at Newbury (6f) last month; big player if coping with drop in trip here

runners.name: Minster Man
runners.spotlight: Second foal from 5f/6f winner; no match for odds-on winner when second of four at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) a fortnight ago but that was still a promising debut, backed up by a good Topspeed figure; dangerous to ignore.
runners.comment: Second of four on recent debut at Yarmouth, recording a good Topspeed figure; considered

runners.name: Barnaby Rudge
runners.spotlight: Hooded for both starts; recovered from slow start to make winning debut at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) in June and followed up at Newcastle (5f, AW) later that month, form that has been very well advertised by the clear second since; has 8lb penalty to carry here but we don't yet know the limit of his ability.
runners.comment: Unbeaten after two starts; this is tricky under 8lb penalty but he still commands respect

runners.name: My Mate Fitz
runners.spotlight: In good hands but showed only minor promise on first two starts (6f/5f; both at Hamilton) and has a lot to find with the principals here.
runners.comment: In good hands but showed only minor promise on first two starts (6f/5f)

runners.name: Sod Hall Lane
runners.spotlight: 95,000euros yearling; second foal; half-brother to an Italian 6f/7.5f 2yo winner; dam runner-up 7f 2yo (RPR 79), sister to 7f Listed winner Fadhayyil, half-sister to Listed winners Cold Stare (7f 2yo) and Zipzip (1m2f), out of 5f Group 3 winner; has useful standard to reach on debut.
runners.comment: Out of a well-connected 7f 2yo runner-up; has useful standard to reach on debut

races.race_name: Copper Blossom Ladies Day Nursery Selling Handicap

runners.name: Bigalo
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in both nurseries, more recently when succumbing to Bluestone Lady's late thrust over C&D (good) a week ago; 3lb higher now but still 3lb better off with the winner, and there was nearly 5l back to Amantha in third.
runners.comment: Clear second to Bluetone Lady over C&D last week and now 3lb better off with her

runners.name: Amantha
runners.spotlight: Led close home to win C&D seller (good) in June and has made the frame in both subsequent nurseries but was well held in third behind Bluestone Lady and Bigalo here a week ago and may have to settle for another minor role.
runners.comment: Won C&D seller in June but well held in third behind two of these over C&D last week

runners.name: Bella Lucia
runners.spotlight: Did pretty well to finish third of 12 in Southwell novice (6f, AW) a fortnight ago, given she was drawn wide and did not have a good track position, and has now been placed on two of her three starts; upped in trip for this nursery debut; no surprise if she features.
runners.comment: Did well to finish third in recent 6f AW novice; up in trip for nursery debut

runners.name: Bluestone Lady
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at eighth attempt, keeping on strongly from off the pace to beat Bigalo and Amantha in C&D (good) nursery a week ago; faces tough task under 6lb penalty (only due 4lb rise) but still respected.
runners.comment: Came good over C&D a week ago; faces tougher task under penalty; still respected

runners.name: Extended Order
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two 7f novice races since winning run-of-the-mill Brighton maiden (6f, good to firm) on debut in May but has travelled from Oxfordshire for this nursery (trainer's only runner on the card) and can't be written off just yet.
runners.comment: Twice well beaten since winning debut but has travelled from Oxfordshire for this

races.race_name: Champagne Pommery Cuvee Louise Gold Cup Handicap

runners.name: Eagle Bay
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who began this season with comfortable wins in Thirsk maiden (7f, good to soft) and Chester novice (7.6f, good); tackles stronger opposition on this handicap debut but needs to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Began this season with two comfortable wins; taken very seriously on this handicap debut

runners.name: Ashen
runners.spotlight: Never really looked dangerous in recent big-field York race won by Jonny Concrete but was in good form beforehand, most notably when winning at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May; each-way claims at least if back on song.
runners.comment: Safely held at York last time but earlier good form gives him an each-way shout

runners.name: Zarvali
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 3yo who won Catterick novice (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in May and ran well in two subsequent handicaps over this trip; didn't fire when tried over 1m last month but may still have some potential.
runners.comment: Didn't fire when tried over 1m last time but began season in good form over 7f; a possible

runners.name: Passing Thought
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten when upped to 1m at Royal Ascot seven weeks ago but is back in much calmer waters here and still has plenty of scope to progress from her winning seasonal/handicap debut at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) in April; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won on seasonal/handicap debut in April and subsequent Royal Ascot defeat can be excused

runners.name: Augustus Gloop
runners.spotlight: 1-7 on AW; ran well before fading into fourth at Wolverhampton (7f) last month, after a break/gelding operation, and remains unexposed over today's trip but needs to find something extra on this turf debut.
runners.comment: Ran well before fading into fourth on AW last month; bit more needed on this turf debut

runners.name: Native Honey
runners.spotlight: Dual winner at Ayr (7f, good to firm/good) this year but his recent record is very mixed and he was last of five over that C&D 11 days ago; not easy to predict here and probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark.
runners.comment: Dual winner at Ayr this year but recent record is very mixed; not easy to predict

runners.name: Jonny Concrete
runners.spotlight: Ran well in defeat on first four starts this season then held on gamely to win 18-runner York handicap (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; effectively 4lb higher here if Jack Nicholls' reduced claim is considered but ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: In good form this year, notably when gamely winning 18-runner York handicap last month

runners.name: Misunderstood
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his French 2yo Group 3 win and yet to be placed after five British starts this year but ran well before fading into seventh of 18 in recent York handicap won by Jonny Concrete and is another 1lb lower here; one to consider.
runners.comment: 0-5 in Britain but ran well when close seventh of 18 at York last month; one to consider

runners.name: Vixey
runners.spotlight: Below form after racing too freely at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) last week but began this season with two good efforts, the latter a close second at Chester (7.6f, good); could have a say.
runners.comment: Below form at Glorious Goodwood last week but began this season with two good efforts

runners.name: Gweedore
runners.spotlight: Now 7lb lower than when making all for narrow C&D (soft) win at end of last season but is yet to strike form after five runs this year; needs a good boost from the first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Ended last season with a C&D win but yet to strike form after five runs this year

runners.name: One Night Thunder
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season and was seemingly back in good form when third at Haydock (7f, good) in May, his second run this year, but two lesser efforts have followed and he now has a point to prove.
runners.comment: Placed at Haydock in May but has a point to prove after two lesser efforts

races.race_name: Champagne Pommery Brut Royal Handicap

runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: Four wins, including over C&D last season; won off 4lb lower over C&D again in April (good) but has finished second five times since, last week going down by a neck in a 6f fillies' handicap at Goodwood (good); 5lb well in; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Four wins last term; C&D win in April; 2nd five times since; 5lb well in; contender

runners.name: Montezuma
runners.spotlight: Mainly in good form since winning over C&D in April (good to soft), last week finishing a neck second here (good, hood on for second time; Jer Batt 0.5l back in third); chance.
runners.comment: C&D win in April; mainly in good form since, including when 3rd over C&D last time; chance
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Big Fun
runners.spotlight: Won a four-runner C&D maiden at 1-6 last July; fair efforts both starts this season; no surprise if he were to run well.
runners.comment: Won four-runner C&D maiden at 1-6 in 2025; fair form in h'caps this term; could go well

runners.name: Ecclefechan
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; second in a C&D novice in 2025, but has raced mainly over further since; beaten over 7l back over 5f at Newmarket last time; bit to prove.
runners.comment: 0-14; 2nd over C&D in 2025; raced mainly over further since; well beaten back at 5f latest

runners.name: Tiva
runners.spotlight: Won three times last season, all over 5f on good/good to firm; yet to score this term, but creditable third at Thirsk last week (5f, good); a possible.
runners.comment: Three wins in 2025, all over 5f, two on good to firm; creditable 3rd last week; a possible

runners.name: Jer Batt
runners.spotlight: Not that easy to win with (2-27 on turf) but is a C&D winner (good to soft) and has run creditably when third over C&D on last two starts (closely matched with Montezuma on last week's run); a possible
runners.comment: 2-27; C&D winner who has finished third over C&D on last two starts; a possible

races.race_name: Brodie Handicap

runners.name: Much
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who kept on well for clear second behind Roc De Fer on recent handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW): due to go up 3lb for that and is 6lb better off with the winner here; likely contender.
runners.comment: 3lb well in after clear second to Roc De Fer on handicap debut a week ago; big player

runners.name: Alnayef
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark when making all to score by 7l at Hamilton (1m5f, good to firm) in June, after a break; managed only third of five when odds-on to follow up there last month and needs to kick on again here.
runners.comment: Belatedly off the mark at Hamilton in June; only third when odds-on there last month

runners.name: Willow Wood
runners.spotlight: Came good with clearcut success at Ffos Las (1m4f, good to soft) in June, her second handicap; below that form after racing too freely on latest outing but remains one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Off the mark in June, her second handicap; race too freely last time; remains of interest

runners.name: Roc De Fer
runners.spotlight: Much-improved 3yo who made all to beat Much at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) a week ago and now bids to complete quick hat-trick under double penalty; needs to prove he's fully effective on turf but has very obvious claims.
runners.comment: Made all on AW last week and now bids to complete quick hat-trick under double penalty

runners.name: Tommy's Promise
runners.spotlight: Won four in a row over 1m2f on Polytrack during the winter but absent since midfield finish in valuable 1m4f race on Good Friday; tries another new trip here; not sure to be suited by the return to turf.
runners.comment: Enjoyed productive winter on Polytrack; returns to turf after a break

runners.name: Sure And Stedfast
runners.spotlight: In the frame three times at Hamilton this year, beaten under 1l when third of five in tactical race on latest occasion four weeks ago (1m5f, good); can go well again here but others look better handicapped.
runners.comment: In the frame three times at Hamilton this year; can go well but others look better treated

runners.name: Simple Star
runners.spotlight: Won over a slightly shorter trip here fpr Dianne Sayer a year ago but has not been firing on all cylinders this season; managed only fourth of six here (2m, good) on last week's stable debut; needs to up his game.
runners.comment: Course winner a year ago but not firing on all cylinders this season

races.race_name: Muirhall Energy Breath Of Fresh Energy Handicap

runners.name: Keep Me Stable
runners.spotlight: Three wins here last summer (7f/1m); bit disappointing this term, but now 3lb lower than last winning mark; stable going well at present; chance.
runners.comment: Three wins here in 2025; below best this term; good mark and stable going well; a chance

runners.name: Misemerald
runners.spotlight: 2-29 on turf; in the frame on last four starts, last week finishing a head second to Monhammer over C&D; chance of turning the form around on 4lb better terms.
runners.comment: In frame on last 4 starts, latest a C&D 2nd to Monhammer; could reverse those placings

runners.name: Chloe's Courage
runners.spotlight: Yet to win on turf, but was a creditable third to an in-form rival at Newmarket when back from a break last month (7f, good to firm); didn't fare as well over 1m at Yarmouth last week (good to firm).
runners.comment: 0-9 on turf; fair 3rd at Newmarket last month (7f); not so good at Yarmouth last week (1m)

runners.name: Filey Beach
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f at Catterick in May (good); not at his best last three runs, but stable back in form and interesting with cheekpieces now tried.
runners.comment: Two 7f wins at Catterick in May; stable going well and interesting with headgear now tried

runners.name: Maui Breeze
runners.spotlight: Has won on the AW (6f, Southwell), but 0-8 on turf and not at her best on last few runs.
runners.comment: AW winner (6f, Southwell) but 0-8 on turf and not at her best on last few runs
runners.owner: H S Hutchinson And W Glass

runners.name: Monhammer
runners.spotlight: Won for the fifth time on turf when holding on by a head from Misemerald in a C&D handicap last week (good); not sure to confirm the placings with the second on 4lb worse terms.
runners.comment: Beat Misemerald by a head over C&D last week; 4lb penalty; may not confirm those placings

races.race_name: Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap

runners.name: Dreambird Dolly
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who's barely put a foot wrong since the blinkers went on; has gone close a couple of times over C&D in the past and is one for the shortlist under experienced 7lb claimer Donagh Murphy.
runners.comment: Front-runner who's barely put a foot wrong since blinkers went on; one for the shortlist
runners.owner: T Beeches, C Stone, J Gallagher

runners.name: Reporter
runners.spotlight: Rather lost his way for Michael Attwater and finished a long way behind Dreambird Dolly for his new yard at Salisbury recently; hard to find a reason why he'll turn things round.
runners.comment: Long way behind Dreambird Dolly for his new yard at Salisbury recently; hard to fancy

runners.name: Hakin Adraar
runners.spotlight: Maiden who offered more at Wolverhampton (7.2f) last month before running as well as could have been expected at the weights in a 6f claimer there last Thursday (first-time blinkers; retained); better treated on turf and not out of this.
runners.comment: More on Tapeta lately; better treated on turf and not out of this dropping in distance

runners.name: Washington Heir
runners.spotlight: Had achieved little prior to springing a surprise in a 0-50 classified event over C&D two months ago; ran to a similar level, back up to 6f, here next time and this is no more competitive back into handicap company.
runners.comment: Better since running here; this is no more competitive back into handicap company

runners.name: Stapleford Park
runners.spotlight: 2yo win came over 7f and he's regressed since joining this yard; ran well down to this trip in March (AW) but typically failed to back it up next time and has been off for a few months since.
runners.comment: Regressed for this yard; ordinary effort last time and has been off for a few months since

runners.name: Recon Mission
runners.spotlight: Doesn't boast a great record round here, has become very hard to win with and the years have looked to be catching up this season; well below market expectations over C&D last time but this is easier again for a yard also responsible for Washington Heir.
runners.comment: Doesn't boast a great record round here but this easier again; still capable at this level

runners.name: Diomed Spirit
runners.spotlight: All six wins for Stuart Williams came on the AW and he's never been as good on turf; handicapped accordingly and this is easier again for his new yard but he ran below par in one previous start here.
runners.comment: Never been as good on turf; handicapped accordingly and this easier again for his new yard

races.race_name: Jenningsbet In Portsmouth EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Enamored
runners.spotlight: Promise at a big price on debut before taking a backward step in a Tapeta novice as favourite last time (main market rival Little Mester behind), having taken a grip; will find this easier.
runners.comment: Had her main market rival Little Mester behind at Southwell latest; will find this easier

runners.name: Little Mester
runners.spotlight: One of four to come away in a Leicester seller a month ago (third gone in since), when a big price on debut; didn't build on that at Southwell a fortnight ago, behind Enamored, but raced keenly and this is less competitive back on turf.
runners.comment: Behind Enamored at Southwell; raced keenly there and this is less competitive back on turf

runners.name: Red Tail
runners.spotlight: Already-gelded 20,000gns yearling who's the first foal of an unraced mare; has been found the right race on debut for a yard that does well here with 2yos.
runners.comment: Gelded 20,000gns yearling; found the right race on debut; yard does well here with 2yos

runners.name: Cruse On Bye
runners.spotlight: Trainer 0-55 with 2yos in the past five seasons; started 150-1 for his Kempton debut in June and ran as expected, finishing a remote last of ten.
runners.comment: 150-1 for his Kempton debut in June and ran as expected, finishing a remote last of ten

runners.name: Napps Way
runners.spotlight: Trainer 0-32 with 2yos this season; it would be a surprise to see this filly get him on the board, having finished well held at a big price on her Chepstow debut a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: Trainer 0-32 with 2yos this season; big price for her Chepstow debut a fortnight ago

races.race_name: Jenningsbet UK's Largest Independent Bookmaker Classified Stakes

runners.name: Outrace
runners.spotlight: Spent most of his career running over a bit shorter in better company than this; cracked late on his return from an absence, having been gelded, at Salisbury a fortnight ago and is entitled to have come on for that; one to consider.
runners.comment: Ran well for long way back from a break recently, having been gelded; can improve; player

runners.name: Myna
runners.spotlight: Consistent enough at a similarly low level all year, winning twice, and there are no concerns regarding track, trip or ground; that's enough to see him shortlisted in a weak affair.
runners.comment: Consistent enough at a similarly low level all year; shortlisted in a weak affair

runners.name: Celebrating Ethel
runners.spotlight: Won this last year and a weak 0-50 on Tapeta in March; has never been anything close to consistent but ran respectably, beaten only 2l despite traffic issues, returned to classified level here (1m) on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Won this last year; beaten only 2l returned to classified level here (1m) on Wednesday

runners.name: Thundering Breeze
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who's been expensive to follow as she's dropped down the levels, including as favourite behind Myna in the winter; will need to improve on previous turf efforts back from six months off.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden who's been expensive to follow; returns from six months off

runners.name: Fitzmaurice
runners.spotlight: Still to make the frame after 14 starts (5f-1m); didn't see it out at Chepstow last time, having pulled hard back in the blinkers (removed today), and will need to settle better if he's to see out the longer trip.
runners.comment: Still to make the frame after 14 starts (5f-1m); needs to settle if he's to see it out

runners.name: Dogged
runners.spotlight: Regressive gelding who become inconsistent; punctuated a string of ordinary efforts with a near-miss in a small field over C&D in June (first-time blinkers) but well held the next twice before fading into a modest third over 1m4f here yesterday.
runners.comment: Not won in three years and become inconsistent; faded over 1m4f here yesterday

races.race_name: Harry Bloom Memorial "Brighton Bullet" Handicap

runners.name: U S S Charleston
runners.spotlight: Fine effort at a big price at Goodwood last Thursday and will be 3lb higher from tomorrow; has not always been the most consistent and has only gone beyond 5f twice before but will rightly be popular.
runners.comment: Fine effort at Goodwood last Thursday; will be 3lb higher from tomorrow; one to consider

runners.name: Cayman Tai
runners.spotlight: Back in form at York last time, despite being rather drawn away from the action in a race in which the leaders didn't stop; a while since he went beyond 5f but this may well be run to suit if he gets some luck once dropped in (as seems likely) from stall 9.
runners.comment: Back in form at York last time; this may well be run to suit if he gets some luck; player

runners.name: Duskaura
runners.spotlight: Made all from the rail draw at Lingfield (turf) a fortnight ago; that came in a far less-competitive handicap off 2lb lower against her own sex, and she'll find this rather tougher.
runners.comment: Made all from the rail draw at Lingfield (turf) a fortnight ago; this somewhat tougher

runners.name: Marcellinus
runners.spotlight: Comeback success came off 10lb lower and he has to prove this mark within range after another defeat as favourite six weeks ago; having Donagh Murphy take off 7lb is a plus, though.
runners.comment: Another defeat as favourite six weeks ago; having Donagh Murphy take off 7lb won't hurt

runners.name: Grey Horizon
runners.spotlight: Progressive of late, despite having had plenty of racing, adding to his C&D win in May (off 9lb lower) when going in at Bath last time (off 3lb lower); there's other pace in here, however, and he'll need another career-best effort.
runners.comment: Progressive of late; other pace in here, however, and he'll need another career-best

runners.name: Tenbob Tommy
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 over this trip, having started life in bumpers, off a 3lb lower mark at Leicester in the spring; that came after a three-month break, which bodes well back from four months out, but this is tougher over an easier 6f.
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 over this trip off a 3lb lower mark at Leicester in the spring; this tougher

runners.name: Bona Fortuna
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden over C&D as a 3yo, returning from eight months off, which is a positive after a break of ten months; expensive to follow in handicaps last season, following a second wind op, and it will be interesting to see how he goes in the market.
runners.comment: Expensive to follow in handicaps last season; interesting to see how he goes in the market

runners.name: Lequinto
runners.spotlight: Eight-time Windsor winner, including twice of late, who's having a first run round here; ultra-consistent, especially considering his age and that he's usually dropped in, but there's little room for manoeuvre off this mark; yard also responsible for Duskaura.
runners.comment: Windsor specialist; ultra-consistent but there's little room for manoeuvre off this mark

runners.name: Ancient Times
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 round Epsom off a 3lb lower mark a month ago and ran to a similar level in defeat last time; might have been better drawn for one happiest on the sharp end but has tended to be reliable once striking form in the past; should go well again.
runners.comment: Tended to be reliable once striking form in the past; should go well again

runners.name: The Quiet Gent
runners.spotlight: Best results for Ralph Beckett, from whom he was picked up for 35,000gns last autumn (gelded not long after), came on the AW; new trainer 3-7 with runners here but an easy 6f looks a bare minimum, especially after such an absence; market useful.
runners.comment: Easy 6f looks a bare minimum for new yard, especially after such an absence; market useful

races.race_name: Bet In Over 200 Shops Nationwide With Jenningsbet Handicap

runners.name: Bated Breeze
runners.spotlight: Can miss the break and/or pull hard but everything panned out when finally winning in a C&D 0-50 classified event a month ago; said to have been suited by being ridden more prominently that day and this no tougher if he can reproduce the effort.
runners.comment: Finally off the mark over C&D last time; this no tougher if he can reproduce the effort

runners.name: Big Time Rascal
runners.spotlight: Landed a second C&D win for Michael Attwater when taking a 0-50 classified event in June; below that level at a short price here a week later and is tried in a first-time tongue-tie for his new yard back into handicap company.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; tried in first-time tongue-tie for his new yard back in handicap company

runners.name: Kodi K
runners.spotlight: Signs of life since handicapping and in latest start he again shaped as though the return to this trip would suit; less exposed than the rest of these and is one to consider.
runners.comment: Less exposed than the rest of these and is one to consider now back up to 6f

runners.name: Rajeteriat
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who's with his third yard; ran poorly back from a break when last seen in June and is having just a second start at beyond 5f, so has questions to answer.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden; having just a second start at beyond 5f, so has questions to answer

runners.name: Dragon God
runners.spotlight: Has often pulled hard and has been suited by the drop to 5f lately, taking advantage of a career-low mark when winning at Yarmouth last weekend; picks up a 5lb penalty for that narrow win and will need to settle better back up to 6f.
runners.comment: Picks up a 5lb penalty for narrow Yarmouth win; will need to settle better back up to 6f

runners.name: Mart
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner for Dylan Cunha, from whom he was picked up for 16,000gns last month having regressed in recent times; fair effort in a first-time tongue-tie for his new yard behind Dragon God on Sunday; chance of turning that round back up to 6f.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner; chance of turning things round with Dragon God back up to 6f

runners.name: Manhattan Chute
runners.spotlight: A long way behind Bated Breeze over C&D a month ago but stronger in the market a week later, when winning a Leicester 0-50; always tended to be hit and miss and be interesting to see how he goes in the betting this time.
runners.comment: Always tended to be hit and miss; interesting to see how he goes in the betting this time
runners.owner: J May, R L Field, W Trenchard, J Pook

races.race_name: Bet Responsibly With Jenningsbet Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Arvana Belle
runners.spotlight: Three solid efforts here last autumn (closed out with a near-miss over C&D off 7lb higher); generally struggled this season but nothing from this yard can be ruled out currently.
runners.comment: Three solid efforts here last autumn; nothing from this yard can be ruled out currently

runners.name: Shes Got The Blues
runners.spotlight: Won a couple of 0-50 classified events in June, including over C&D, before held under a penalty in a Windsor handicap over further; perhaps that came too soon in a race that didn't pan out her way and she could well bounce back.
runners.comment: Won a couple of 0-50 classified events in June, including over C&D; could well bounce back

runners.name: Superstorm
runners.spotlight: Regressive gelding who's had plenty of chances, in two forms of headgear; the handicapper's been quick to ease off and the step back up from 6f should help but his best efforts have come on the AW.
runners.comment: Handicapper's been quick to ease off and the step back up from 6f should help; chance

runners.name: Pennine Way
runners.spotlight: Well-related filly who ran below market expectations on her first two handicap starts; better effort on Tapeta last time, when always well positioned, gave some hope and she's one to consider in a weak affair.
runners.comment: Better run on Tapeta last time gave some hope and she's one to consider in a weak affair

runners.name: Snow Day
runners.spotlight: Serial slow starter who's still to get involved in a finish; not beaten far last time, again at a huge price, but She Got The Blues is clearly her yard's best chance.
runners.comment: Not beaten far latest (huge price again) but She Got The Blues is her yard's best chance

runners.name: Solar Phoenix
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress in three runs last backend and was beaten some way on his seasonal/handicap debut in June; the drop in trip in first-time blinkers will need to make a difference.
runners.comment: Well held on return; the drop in trip/first-time blinkers will need to make a difference

runners.name: King Cherry
runners.spotlight: Buzzy in early runs and is still to offer much, again finishing well held from the front over C&D on Wednesday (hung badly left as he tired); hard to recommend after that.
runners.comment: Buzzy in early runs and again finished well held from the front over C&D on Wednesday

races.race_name: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes

runners.name: Tarlac
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 23 starts but he made a bold bid and was only narrowly denied in a Hamilton handicap (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; has leading claims if he can back that up.
runners.comment: Record of 1-23 but he went very close at Hamilton three weeks ago; leading claims
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Mister Sky Blue
runners.spotlight: Close second in a Hamilton handicap (6f, good to soft) in June but he's not come close to that form in three subsequent runs; overall record is now 1-24 and he needs to rediscover his spark; blinkers worn in last three starts are removed.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Hamilton in June but he's not come close to that form since and is now 1-24

runners.name: Golden Prosperity
runners.spotlight: Frequent slow starter who was never involved at Redcar last time but he was placed over C&D (good to firm) last month and he won at Catterick (5f, good) in April; has claims if he can get away on terms, and his penultimate win was in this race last year.
runners.comment: Won this race last year and he's a player if he gets a good pace and some luck

runners.name: Tickets
runners.spotlight: The last of his five wins was in a classified event at Newcastle (6f, AW) for Ben Haslam in February; made a solid start for new yard when runner-up there (tongue-tie added) in June and he's respected in suitable conditions back on turf.
runners.comment: Runner-up on stable debut at Newcastle (6f, AW) and he's respected back on turf

runners.name: Mrs Trump
runners.spotlight: Five-time sprint winner including over C&D; her last success was 13 months ago but she showed signs of a revival when a 2l fifth in a Redcar handicap (6f, good to firm) last week; has possibilities if she can build on that.
runners.comment: C&D winner who showed signs of a revival at Redcar last week; in the mix
runners.owner: R Chapman, G J Daly & R J Parks

runners.name: Drish Samphire
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has yet to be placed and was beaten 6l at a big price in a classified event at Newcastle (6f, AW) last Friday; hood worn in her last seven starts is now removed.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has yet to be placed and was well held in a classified last week

runners.name: Newyorkstateofmind
runners.spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on the AW and his last turf win was over two years ago; finished well when runner-up at Catterick (5f, good) in May but he's been quiet since and reared at the start when down the field at Ayr last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: His last turf win was in 2024 and he's been quiet since his Catterick second in May

runners.name: Hurstwood
runners.spotlight: 11-time winner who scored twice last year but he's been generally disappointing in six runs this season; handles most ground but he needs to raise his game to make a serious impact.
runners.comment: 11-time winner but he's been generally disappointing this season; needs to raise his game
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

runners.name: Thank The Lord
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner but his last success was in February 2024; ended last year with a close call at Newcastle (5f, AW) but he's been out of sorts since and was last of 14 at Doncaster in April; has plenty to prove and he needs a major revival after a break.
runners.comment: Struggled in the spring and he needs a major revival after 105 days off

races.race_name: Bob Vickery Memorial Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Time Glory
runners.spotlight: Made an encouraging start at Redcar in May and she built on that with a front-running third at York (5f, good); just about sets the standard on that form but she flopped at Catterick (last of six) last month and needs to bounce back after that disappointing effort.
runners.comment: Has leading claims on her third at York but she flopped last time; needs to bounce back

runners.name: My Maria
runners.spotlight: Has reached the frame in all four starts and she found improvement when a close second in a Leicester nursery (5f, good to firm) last week; hung right last time but cheekpieces are now added and she should make another bold bid back in a maiden.
runners.comment: Runner-up in last two starts including a close call at Leicester last week; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Inglewood
runners.spotlight: Promising fifth on Thirsk debut in May and she took a good step forward when a rallying second at Catterick (5f, good to firm) last month; that form puts her in the picture and she's open to more progress; dangerous.
runners.comment: Rallied well when runner-up at Catterick and she's open to more progress; dangerous

runners.name: Travellers Girl
runners.spotlight: Placed in 6f novice events in two of her four starts including at Thirsk (good to firm) last month; looked stretched when upped to 7f at York last time but has something to prove dropped to 5f and has something to find on the figures; others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Placed twice in her four runs but she has something to find at this new trip

runners.name: Mollisha
runners.spotlight: £27,000 breeze-up 2yo; attracted support at big prices on recent Newcastle debut (6f, AW; 16-1) and she came from off the pace to finish a close third of 14; likely player if building on that promising effort and coping with this drop in trip.
runners.comment: £27,000 breeze-up 2yo; promising third on recent Newcastle debut (6f) and she's in the mix

runners.name: Dorothea Hope
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth at a big price on Beverley debut (5f, good to firm) last month but she didn't live up to market expectations on her return visit eight days later; has bit to prove after that and she needs improvement.
runners.comment: Didn't live up to market expectations at Beverley last time and she needs improvement

runners.name: Takeaselfie
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 1m AW winner Nushafreen (RPR 78); dam once-raced sister to 1m2f winner High Baroque, out of Irish 1,000 Guineas winner and Oaks runner-up Yesterday (sister to Oaks/Irish Oaks runner-up Quarter Moon); has a striking pedigree but she could be one for longer trips later on.
runners.comment: Has a striking pedigree but she could be one for longer trips later on

runners.name: Basmaah
runners.spotlight: 18,000euros yearling, £16,000 breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f AW winner Bloodsweatandtyres (RPR 77); dam unraced sister to winners Move In Time (5f Group 1) and Razzmatazz (useful 6f), half-sister to useful 5f winner Meadway; one of two runners for yard and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: £16,000 breeze-up 2yo; one of two runners for yard and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Estella Havisham
runners.spotlight: £46,000 yearling; first foal; dam 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 93), half-sister to useful 7f-1m2f winner Montather, out of Listed-placed 7f 2yo/1m winner from family of 1,000 Guineas winner Shadayid; yard 26% with 2yos this year and she needs a close look on debut.
runners.comment: £46,000 yearling; yard 26% with 2yos this year and she needs a close look on debut

runners.name: Prosperity Angel
runners.spotlight: £50,000 yearling by Harry Angel; finished third of ten on Catterick debut (5f, good to firm; 16-1) last month but she looked awkward under pressure and was beaten almost 6l; should know more this time but she has a lot to find with the principals.
runners.comment: Placed on Catterick debut last month but she was beaten almost 6l; down the list

runners.name: Purrista
runners.spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; ran into some trouble when a promising third on recent Beverley debut (5f, good to firm; 11-1) but that form is modest and she needs plenty of progress to make a serious impact here.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise when third on recent Beverley debut but that form is modest

runners.name: Veruca Salt
runners.spotlight: Ran green after a slow start and was never involved when a remote fifth of ten at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; has a lot to find on this drop in trip and she remains best watched for now.
runners.comment: Made a low-key start at Wolverhampton and she has a lot to find on this drop in trip

runners.name: Shaniko
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) on her second start but she's struggled in her other two runs and was beaten 11l in a small field at Redcar (RPR 40) last time; others preferred
runners.comment: Runner-up at Nottingham in June but she's struggled in her other two runs; opposable

races.race_name: Peter Bell Memorial Fillies' Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Gerry's Darling
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt when making all for an emphatic win in a Musselburgh maiden (7f, good; 11-8 favourite) last Thursday; looks well treated under a penalty for that success and she's open to more progress on this nursery debut; big player.
runners.comment: Bolted up at Musselburgh last week and she looks well treated under a penalty; big player

runners.name: Priscilla's Hope
runners.spotlight: Well held in all five starts including when fifth of eighth on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; dropped 3lb but she needs plenty of progress on this step up to 7f.
runners.comment: Well held in all five starts and she needs plenty of progress at this new trip

runners.name: Bonjour Belle
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in a Chester seller (7f, good to soft) on debut in June but she's struggled in two maidens since; still early days but this looks a tough assignment on nursery debut and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Struggled in maidens in last two starts and needs a transformation on nursery debut

runners.name: Spirit Of Mary
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden but she's been placed in both nurseries and her latest third was at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago; has shaped as though this new trip could suit but this is competitive and she's 6lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Placed in nurseries in her last two runs but this is a tough task from out of the weights

runners.name: Love Tanya
runners.spotlight: Remote third of five on Carlisle debut in June but she showed promise when runner-up in a C&D novice (good to firm) last month; should continue to improve with experience but she needs another major step forward to make an impact off this opening mark.
runners.comment: Showed promise when runner-up over C&D latest but she needs more progress on nursery debut

runners.name: Bymiddaytomorrow
runners.spotlight: Improved form upped to 7f when justifying support with a comfortable win in a maiden at Ayr (good to firm; 9-4) last week; this is tougher under a penalty on nursery debut but she's still unexposed and is bred to be useful; respected for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Comfortable win in a maiden at Ayr last week; respected under a penalty on nursery debut

races.race_name: Ladies' Day Saturday 5th September - Book Now Handicap

runners.name: J Street
runners.spotlight: In-form 4yo who has won twice over 5f (AW/good to firm) this summer and she didn't get the best of runs when a close fourth of 11 at Chester (5f, good) last time; on same mark here and she should be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Two wins this summer and she finished a close fourth at Chester last time; key player

runners.name: Military Girl
runners.spotlight: Better than ever this season, with form figures of 3112, and her latest win was over C&D (good); usually comes from off the pace and she split two rivals who raced more prominently when runner-up here in June; returns after a short break but she's strongly respected off same mark as last time.
runners.comment: Record of 2-4 this season and was runner-up over C&D last time; strongly respected

runners.name: Azuinthejungle
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row last season and he's got back on the scoresheet with wins at Ayr (6f) and Beverley (5f, both on good to firm) in his last two starts; has a penalty for his last success but that was a personal best and he's a big player in this hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: Won at Ayr and Beverley in last two runs and he's a big player in hat-trick bid
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Qila
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who showed clear promise in novice events but he was beaten 14l on his handicap debut at Carlisle (5f, good to soft) in June; had wind surgery since but he needs to bounce back with tongue-tie added after a short break.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo but he was beaten 14l on handicap debut in June; had wind surgery since

runners.name: Glory Fighter
runners.spotlight: Front-running veteran who has won 11 times including over C&D; got pestered for the lead at Catterick last time but he's been disappointing since his win at Nottingham (5f, good) in April and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Prolific winner but he's been disappointing since making all at Nottingham in April

runners.name: Vince L'Amour
runners.spotlight: Recorded his fifth turf win when scoring at Ripon (5f, good) in May but he's struggled since and has failed to beat a rival in his last three starts; now 3lb lower than for his last success but he needs a big turnaround.
runners.comment: Won at Ripon in May but he's struggled since and has a lot to prove

races.race_name: William Hill, Market Place, Thirsk Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Sudu
runners.spotlight: Built on his handicap debut with a 7l success at Epsom (1m4f, good) last July; raised 11lb for that success and was well held having raced keenly at Goodwood (1m4f) next time; has been off for 373 days and has the hood applied for his return; watch the market.
runners.comment: 7l winner at Epsom last July but has been off for over a year; hood is applied for return
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late John Connolly

runners.name: Wanderlust
runners.spotlight: Sole win from ten starts came at Angers (1m2f, soft) last September on his final start for Andre Fabre; gelded ahead of his fourth at Chester on his stable debut in May and has ran respectably in both starts since; steps back up to 1m4f with each-way claims.
runners.comment: Soft-ground winner in France (1m2f); ran respectably in both starts since his stable debut

runners.name: Master Vintner
runners.spotlight: Won last September on his first two starts for this yard (heavy/AW); disappointing favourite at Newmarket (1m4f, good) on his reappearance but he's been runner-up at Kempton in both starts since; switches back to turf with blinkers now tried; contender.
runners.comment: Heavy ground and AW winner; runner-up at Kempton on his last two starts; blinkers added
runners.owner: R A Pegum And Paul Anthony Henry

runners.name: Golden West
runners.spotlight: Won his first two starts when trained by Karl Burke; encouraging stable debut at Chester (1m2f, good to soft) in June and was best of the rest behind a handicap blot at Carlisle next time; however, he needs to bounce back from a lesser effort at York (1m4f, good to firm) last month.
runners.comment: Dual winner for Karl Burke; first two efforts for this yard were good but poor last time

runners.name: Wahdan
runners.spotlight: AW winner when trained in France but he was mostly disappointing for Joseph O'Brien last year; best effort for this stable came when a 2l sixth of 14 at York (1m, good) in June but he didn't fully prove his stamina for this far when an 11l third there 13 days ago; cheekpieces, worn once previously, are back on.
runners.comment: AW winner in France; best effort for this yard came when a 2l sixth of 14 over 1m at York

runners.name: Majestic
runners.spotlight: Won the 2022 Cambridgeshire but his only win since came in Bahrain (1m2f, good) last January; came from further back than the winner when runner-up at Windsor (around 1m4f) in June but he failed to beat a rival home over 1m6f at Newmarket last month; drop back in trip should suit.
runners.comment: Runner-up at around 1m4f at Windsor in June but last of ten over 1m6f at Newmarket latest

races.race_name: Country Music Night Here Next Friday 14th August Handicap

runners.name: Maximum Velocity
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 11 starts came over 7f at Redcar in May off a mark 10lb lower than today's, but he posted his best effort when going close at Leicester (6f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) last time; can go well.
runners.comment: 1-11; posted his best effort when going close in first-time cheekpieces at Leicester
runners.owner: In For A Penny Partnership & Partner

runners.name: Overbudget
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on her first three starts but she's been well held in three handicaps, including at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in June on her final start for Dylan Cunha; watch the betting on her stable debut.
runners.comment: Well held in three handicaps, including at Doncaster in June; yard debut; watch betting
runners.owner: Matt Broughton & Hold My Beer Syndicate

runners.name: Great Profit
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden but he's found only one too good in three of his four starts since joining this stable, including at Ayr (6f, good to firm; lost a shoe) 11 days ago; solid chance.
runners.comment: 0-7; runner-up in three of his four starts for this stable and holds solid claims

runners.name: Lope Y Linda
runners.spotlight: Doubled her tally when winning a classified event at Ayr (7f, soft) in June before a good second there in a handicap next time; did too much too soon and didn't get home over 1m at Leicester two weeks ago, and this free-going sort could go well now dropping back to 6f.
runners.comment: Dual 7f winner; didn't get home over 1m last time; could go well back down in trip

runners.name: Liquid Cooled
runners.spotlight: Gelded prior to winning at Newcastle (6f, AW; first start for 82 days) in March and his next two efforts were solid (6f/1m); however, he was well held at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last time after another 82-day break and needs to take a step forward from that.
runners.comment: Gelded prior to winning at Newcastle in March; well held last time after a 82-day break

runners.name: Agric Ranger
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has beaten only one rival home in two handicaps (6f/5f; good to firm/AW); this unexposed gelding now steps back up in trip but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: 0-5 and has beaten only one rival home in two handicaps; others have stronger claims

runners.name: Soul Warrior
runners.spotlight: Won on his handicap debut at Redcar (6f, good to soft) in September and bounced back from two lesser efforts when third at Ripon (6f, good); below that level having raced freely over 7f last time but should be happier back down in trip.
runners.comment: Won at Redcar in September; raced freely over 7f last time and now drops back in trip
runners.owner: D Jenkins J Glover R O'Donnell J Short

runners.name: Mare Of London
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was sixth of nine on her stable debut and first start for 306 days at Ripon (6f, good) last month; seemed to find the drop back to 5f against her when seventh here two weeks ago and now steps back up in trip off a career-low mark.
runners.comment: 0-8 but unsuited by the drop back to 5f when seventh here latest; steps back up in trip
runners.owner: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club

runners.name: Hellcat
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; kept on into third of six at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in May but she's been below that level in both starts since, including there last month; others are preferred.
runners.comment: 0-8; third at Wolverhampton in May but below that level in two starts since

runners.name: Real Jack
runners.spotlight: Placed in one of his seven outings and finished midfield over this C&D in June; disappointed in first-time cheekpieces (now removed) at Ayr (7f, soft) in June and now returns to 6f having been dropped another 3lb.
runners.comment: Disappointed on soft in first-time cheekpieces (removed) in June; drops back down to 6f

runners.name: Yellow Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Won a soft-ground 5f novice last October on her final start for Kevin Philippart De Foy; has posted some respectable efforts for this stable but couldn't get involved over 5f here three weeks ago; down 2lb and has each-way claims stepped up to 6f.
runners.comment: Won a soft-ground novice for previous yard; steps up to 6f with each-way claims

races.race_name: 1XBET.IE IRISH RACING PARTNERSHIP Optional Claiming Race

runners.name: Rock Iguana
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; AW winner in Britain for Kevin Phillipart De Foy; last seen finishing midfield in a Kempton handicap in May off 81; rider's claim eases welter burden and he'd be conceding much more weight to most of these in a handicap; interesting on stable bow.
runners.comment: AW winner in Britain, rated 80, rider claims handy 7lb, interesting on stable debut

runners.name: Thurso
runners.spotlight: Won four for Richard Hughes (three on turf) at 5.5f-7f; promising start for this yard at Navan in June but never figured when failing to beat a rival back at Navan on latest; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Four-time winner in Britain, good start for this yard at Navan, didn't back it up latest

runners.name: Mo Anam Chara
runners.spotlight: Confirmed promise shown at Dundalk last year when well backed and winning a maiden claimer at Roscommon in May (7.5f, gd-yld); not seen since, which is a slight concern, but should go well if she's ready to rock.
runners.comment: Won Roscommon maiden claimer on latest in May, off since, chance if ready to rock

runners.name: Inishfallen
runners.spotlight: Form of penultimate neck second in a rated race at Limerick was franked by the winner (to whom he was conceding 6lb) who bolted up off 80 in a handicap at Galway last week; yielding ground not ideal on latest; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Form of penultimate second franked at Galway, ground not ideal latest, may rebound
runners.owner: F J Carragher/Yorkavenue Syndicate/Park Ave Syndicate

runners.name: Profit Surge
runners.spotlight: Maiden has finished in the first three in five of her nine runs on turf; narrowly denied in C&D claimer in May; beaten just 0.75l off 62 in a 7f Naas handicap latest; should be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied in C&D claimer in May, good h'cap run latest, on the premises again

runners.name: Spirit Of Eagles
runners.spotlight: Beaten off 59 in handicaps on last three starts but did win her last start in claiming company at Fairyhouse in May (6f, good); this is a better race and a bit to find on the figures.
runners.comment: Won last start in claiming company, this is harder, a bit to find on the figures

runners.name: Princess Chloe
runners.spotlight: 3yo maiden ran her best race to date over C&D on latest, beaten 1.75l in a handicap off 60; previously finished second at Limerick (6.5f, good) off 57; cheekpieces go on and not dismissed on first try in claiming company.
runners.comment: Solid handicap runs last twice inc' over C&D, not dismissed on first try in claimer

runners.name: Slight Of Foot
runners.spotlight: Best run in Britain a 1l second in a 7f Kempton novice last autumn; form ordinary otherwise and soundly beaten in a Galway handicap off 73 on debut for this yard last week.
runners.comment: Runner up in Kempton AW novice last autumn, moderate start for this yard at Galway

runners.name: Green Kite
runners.spotlight: Placed twice, in a soft ground Killarney maiden last October (1m) and runner up off 63 in a soft ground Leopardstown handicap in June (7f); rated 62 so poorly treated and could probably do with some rain.
runners.comment: Placed twice on soft ground, rated 62 so poorly treated here, could do with some rain

runners.name: Spent All Me Money
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden claimer at Roscommon and a 7f Naas handicap last season but has completely lost way since; beaten 18l at Galway on latest; revival needed.
runners.comment: Lost way since winning at Naas last season, beaten 18l latest, needs revival

runners.name: Snowballs
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-10 on turf and rated 39; always behind when beating just one rival home at Cork (6f, gd-fm) on latest; steps up to 7f; visor back on but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Maiden, 0-10 on turf and rated just 39, beat just one rival home at Cork on latest

runners.name: Cladach
runners.spotlight: Moderate efforts in both starts in maidens; remote fourth at Fairyhouse (7f, good) and down the field at Cork (6f, gd-fm); now drops into claiming company and major improvement required.
runners.comment: Modest form in two maidens, drops into claiming company, major improvement required

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; shed the maiden tag in a 9.5f handicap here (good) off 59 on his penultimate start; soundly beaten off revised mark at Galway, though trip/ground not ideal there; drawn wide and trip may be on sharp side.
runners.comment: Won over 9.5f here on penultimate, excuses at Galway but this trip may be too sharp

runners.name: Menwirr
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; 3yo showed modest form in four starts for Archie Watson; rating of 60 may flatter him; best watched on first start for new stable after a 73 day break.
runners.comment: Modest form in four runs for Archie Watson, best watched on first run for 73 days

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners.name: Rebel Wave
runners.spotlight: 3yo off the mark at the fourth attempt in maidens at the Curragh (7f,gd-fm) last month; previously a head behind Expert Dancer at Limerick and she ran a cracker in a handicap at Galway off 80 so an opening mark of 79 may be workable; could go well in first handicap.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the Curragh latest, opening mark could be workable on h'cap debut

runners.name: Pretty Omagh Girl
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on seasonal return in a Curragh handicap (1m, good), making all in dominant fashion; hit hard for that with a 10lb rise and came up short in premier handicap back at the Curragh on latest (coughing post-race); needs to rebound dropped in trip.
runners.comment: Up 10lb for easy Curragh win, needs to bounce back from poor run latest, drops in trip

runners.name: Hasita
runners.spotlight: 3yo; modest form last year but has run well in defeat in three of four starts this season, including when beaten 1l on handicap debut at Fairyhouse on her penultimate start (7f, good); didn't fire dropped to 6f in first time cheekpieces (discarded) in a Navan maiden last time; not dismissed back up in trip returned to a handicap.
runners.comment: Good run off 1lb lower on h'cap bow penultimate, 6f didn't suit latest, up in trip a plus
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Stugardia
runners.spotlight: Smart form in Germany for Henk Grewe last year included three placed efforts in Listed company; bought for E100,000 at Arqana in December; overlooked by McMonagle and probably best watched on Irish and stable debut unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Smart form in Germany, bought for E100,000, market can guide on stable debut

runners.name: Greydreambeliever
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard and the choice of McMonagle; beaten a short head by Rion Rubette in a C&D handicap on yielding in June and 3lb better off with that rival now; not disgraced in Listed race at Galway on latest; majority of best form on easy ground so could probably do with some rain.
runners.comment: 3lb swing with Rion Rubette for short head defeat over C&D in June, rain would help cause
runners.owner: K Blake/Mrs E Palmer/M Wilson/N Luck

runners.name: Mallavelly
runners.spotlight: Found just the progressive Meriden too good in a 7f Curragh premier handicap on her latest start in June; another solid run over 1m there on latest; worth another go over this shorter trip and is just 2lb higher than when winning this race last season (run at Tipperary); claims.
runners.comment: Solid runs over 7f-1m at the Curragh the last twice, won this last year off 2lb higher

runners.name: Rion Rubette
runners.spotlight: Gained back-to-back C&D wins earlier this season, beating Greydreambeliever by a short head in the second one; no impact off revised mark in Curragh premier handicap on latest (8l behind Malavelly); these are calmer waters and could bounce back at her favourite track.
runners.comment: 2-2 over C&D, no impact in premier handicap at the Curragh latest, this is easier

runners.name: Thrifty Of Digby
runners.spotlight: Decent strike rate of 5-22 (three wins here); back-to-back wins at Roscommon (7.5f, gd-yld) and here (9.5f, yld) in May-June; went up 10lb for those two victories but that wasn't the reason why she was pulled up at Down Royal on latest (lost action/scoped dirty); can only be watched after that.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner, pulled up at Down Royal latest, can only watch after that

runners.name: Akecheta
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come on soft to heavy ground, including a conditions race over C&D last September; handles quicker conditions but this year's form has not been her best; heavy defeat over 9.5f here on latest; others arrive in better fettle.
runners.comment: Both wins on soft to heavy inc' over C&D, below best this term, others in better fettle

races.race_name: Edward Doran's Birthday Handicap

runners.name: Bofa Beach
runners.spotlight: 3yo; definite potential in a couple of maidens including one here over 1m; didn't quite see out 1m at Naas on latest and now drops back to 7f for her handicap debut and could be on a workable mark; yard in fine form but Foley prefers stablemate.
runners.comment: 3yo, promise in a couple of maidens, drops to 7f for h'cap debut, mark could be workable

runners.name: Caitouna
runners.spotlight: Won second handicap start in a fillies' event at Fairyhouse (7f, good) in July off 4lb lower under Colin Keane; has come up short twice since, though yielding ground probably not ideal at Galway last time; eased 2lb, cheekpieces go on and Keane returns.
runners.comment: Won off 4lb lower under Keane at Fairyhouse, poor twice since, cheekpieces go on

runners.name: Morehampton
runners.spotlight: 3yo won his maiden over C&D (good) last August; poor form this term and mark is tumbling but held behind a few of these in Limerick rated race on latest and others look more convincing right now.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner last year, held behind a few of these at Limerick latest

runners.name: Fortuity
runners.spotlight: 3yo shed the maiden tag at Fairyhouse (7f, good) in May off 3lb lower; struggled on soft at Leopardstown then didn't get home upped to 8.5f back at Fairyhouse on latest; drop back to 7f looks a big plus and preferred by Foley.
runners.comment: Won last start at 7f on good at Fairyhouse, 8.5f too far latest, preferred by Foley

runners.name: Ohailbhic
runners.spotlight: In excellent form at Dundalk earlier this year; 0-9 on turf and moderate effort at Naas (6f, good) on return from 124 days off on latest; strip fitter now and 7f more suitable so not totally discounted.
runners.comment: AW winner, 0-9 on turf, strip fitter for latest, this trip more suitable, not dismissed

runners.name: Bundle Of Interest
runners.spotlight: Scored off 2lb lower at Navan (6f, good) in July last year and went close over 7f (heavy) here in October behind Ribee; never involved on seasonal return at Naas in May (6f, good) and off since; capable off this mark so check the market.
runners.comment: Won off 2lb lower at Navan last year, modest return at Naas in May, check market

runners.name: Neo Smart
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner is just 1-29 on turf but she ran a good race at the Curragh (1m, good) on her penultimate start (beaten 2l, denied clear run); not as good upped to 1m2f latest but drops back in trip now and could go well off 1lb lower than she was at the Curragh.
runners.comment: Fine fourth when denied clear run at the Curragh, 1m2f too far latest, this trip will suit

runners.name: Tokyo Treasure
runners.spotlight: Minor promise in maidens last year; not a bad run at all in Limerick rated race on seasonal return last month, beaten just 3.75l (1.75l behind Alfred Tennyson); 7lb better off with that rival now, should be sharper and eye-catching rider booking for handicap bow; interesting.
runners.comment: Sharper for return in Limerick rated race, weighted to turn tables on Alfred Tennyson

runners.name: Ballymagreehan
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on turf over 1m here (gd-yld) in May; seemingly anchored by 10lb rise twice since and handicapper slow to relent; a bit to prove off his current mark.
runners.comment: Won over 1m here in May, anchored by 10lb rise twice since, a bit to prove off this mark

runners.name: Reimagined
runners.spotlight: 3yo won a restricted novice at Windsor (6f, good) last year for Eve Johnson Houghton; weakened late on under positive ride on first try over 7f at Dundalk on latest; stamina to prove for this trip.
runners.comment: 6f novice win in Britain, weakened on first try at 7f latest, stamina to prove

runners.name: Send Harry
runners.spotlight: AW winner has yet to score on turf but plenty of good runs in defeat including when ahead of a couple of these in a Limerick rated race on penultimate; ground not ideal at Galway latest; place chance back on sounder surface.
runners.comment: Ahead of a couple of these in rated race penultimate, ground excuse latest, place shout

runners.name: Alfred Tennyson
runners.spotlight: Yet to win since joining this yard and not the most consistent but ran a fine race at Galway (7f, yielding) last week when beaten 2l off 75; good ground is fine but needs to back that up now off 1lb higher.
runners.comment: Nudged up 1lb for latest Galway third, trip/ground fine here, needs to back that up now

runners.name: Summer Snow
runners.spotlight: Won at Galway in 2025 off 9lb higher and is a two-time C&D winner but yet to find form this season; beaten 13l when down the field at the Curragh latest; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner, yet to fire this season, needs to get back on track

races.race_name: 1XBET.IE RACING LEGACY Handicap

runners.name: Sunrise Angel
runners.spotlight: Threatened in nurseries last season but not so good this campaign, though had a wide trip last time at Killarney; might endure another here from stall 13.
runners.comment: Threatened in nurseries last season but not so good this campaign

runners.name: Glamazon
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m1f Ballinrobe maiden in May; responded well to first-time blinkers when fourth two runs ago, so might go well should the visor have a similar effect.
runners.comment: 1-15 and the win was in a maiden; has run well in new headgear previously

runners.name: Sayonara
runners.spotlight: Started out as a sprinter; signs of finding his level when fourth of 12 last time at Killarney and didn't quite see out the 1m; respected back at 7f.
runners.comment: Signs of finding his level when fourth of 12 at Killarney and didn't quite see out the 1m

runners.name: Beau Army
runners.spotlight: Won twice on the AW during the winter; her near 4l third at Killarney (1m, good) last month was her best effort on turf but then fared less well tried in cheekpieces over C&D; bit risky in a new visor.
runners.comment: Third two runs ago but since disappointed in cheekpieces and now goes in a visor

runners.name: Fontaine Khaled
runners.spotlight: Eight defeats include five handicaps but competitive in two of those (6f/7f) and should have a race in her off this mark; 1m perhaps too far last time.
runners.comment: Eight defeats include five handicaps but competitive in two of those (6f/7f)
runners.owner: Dan Kiely & C O'Neill & Apollo Thoroughbreds

runners.name: He's Holding Court
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has tried a few trips and she's not progressing; now tries new headgear.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who has tried a few trips and she's not progressing; now in new headgear

runners.name: Kingcharles
runners.spotlight: Showed a bit more when eighth of 12 in a 1m maiden at Galway last week; may improve again now moving into handicaps off a modest mark.
runners.comment: Showed a bit more when eighth of 12 in a 1m maiden at Galway last week

runners.name: Garryowen Green
runners.spotlight: Keeps getting a little closer in handicaps, last time beaten 6l over C&D 13 days ago; down another 3lb.
runners.comment: Keeps getting a little closer in handicaps, last time beaten 6l over C&D 13 days ago

runners.name: Ochtar Againn
runners.spotlight: 0-7 but her first run in cheekpieces when beaten 3l over Limerick's extended 6f a month ago and she might build on that.
runners.comment: 0-7 but her first run in cheekpieces when beaten 3l over Limerick's extended 6f

runners.name: Make The Tide
runners.spotlight: Unfancied and ran accordingly in maidens; 12-1 for handicap debut at Leopardstown (1m, good) but again finished down the field; drawn wide.
runners.comment: 12-1 for handicap debut at Leopardstown (1m, good) but again finished down the field

runners.name: Gilts
runners.spotlight: Little in maidens but sprung a 28-1 surprise on handicap debut over C&D two months ago (yielding) when always prominent from a low draw; 7lb higher with Jack Cleary again claiming his 5lb; should feature.
runners.comment: Always prominent for a winning handicap debut over C&D; 7lb higher

runners.name: Churchfield Lady
runners.spotlight: A bit better for cheekpieces over 1m here 13 days ago but again she was uncompetitive, finishing some 11l off the winner in a maiden; handicap debut.
runners.comment: A bit better for cheekpieces over 1m here 13 days ago but again she was uncompetitive

runners.name: Ballerina Dancer
runners.spotlight: Beaten 18l+ in three maidens from 7f-1m; all to prove on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Beaten 18l+ in three maidens from 7f-1m; all to prove on handicap debut

runners.name: Oppenheimer
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and first start after a gelding operation when running on well to be seventh of 20 over 6f at the Curragh in early May (good); of strong interest raised in distance despite the three-month absence.
runners.comment: Off since early May but that was his best effort yet over 6f when running on

runners.name: Miss Ivor
runners.spotlight: Little of note in five efforts, four on turf and including a handicap at this sort of trip; opposable.
runners.comment: Little of note in five efforts, four on turf and including a handicap at this sort of trip

races.race_name: Coolmore Stud Churchill Stakes (Listed Race) (Registered as the El Gran Senor Stakes)

runners.name: Sea Of Rain
runners.spotlight: Took her five goes to get off the mark but she clocked a good time when making all at Leopardstown (7f, good) and she's clearly progressing; has every chance according to Topspeed/RPR figures.
runners.comment: Took her five goes to get off the mark but she clocked a good time at Leopardstown

runners.name: Bellesque
runners.spotlight: Quality pedigree; second to a smart prospect at Leopardstown (7f) and then made all on her return visit (1m, good), denying the well-touted So Lovely who again went close last week at Glorious Goodwood; promising filly and the chosen mount of Dylan Browne McMonagle.
runners.comment: Made all to beat a good one at Leopardstown and she's a promising filly
runners.owner: Mrs E Irwin & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Sergei Diaghilev
runners.spotlight: Workmanlike on debut when odds-on at the Curragh (6f, good) and again sent off favourite for the Windsor Castle (6f, good to firm) where he lacked the gears to land any sort of blow (third of nine in his group); seemingly held in some regard and could be a different proposition now raised 2f in distance.
runners.comment: Both runs at 6f, winning on debut then 9th at Ascot; better expected now raised to 1m
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

runners.name: Full Volume
runners.spotlight: Clearcut Bellewstown winner but couldn't repel Venetian Power at Killarney (again over 1m on good) despite dictating matters up front; might do well to reverse those placings and there are others to worry about.
runners.comment: Held by Venetian Power on their recent clash and there are others to worry about

runners.name: Venetian Power
runners.spotlight: His debut form gives him a bit to find with City Of Dubai but he stepped up on that effort to narrowly deny Full Volume at Killarney (1m, good); every chance that he'll confirm those placings and go very close.
runners.comment: Fulfilled debut promise when too strong at Killarney for Full Volume

runners.name: City Of Dubai
runners.spotlight: 260,000euros yearling; 8-1 but knew his job when prevailing narrowly in a bunched finish to a traditionally warm 1m maiden at Killarney last month; nice prospect.
runners.comment: Only prevailed narrowly but that's always a good maiden that he won at Killarney

races.race_name: 1XBET.IE COMMUNITY CHAMPIONS Race

runners.name: Celtic Motif
runners.spotlight: Some notable form in 2yo maidens for this yard and went on to perform well in the US; at odds of 1-5 she duly outclassed her rivals in a Killarney maiden last month and interesting that she was engaged in a Group 3 at Leopardstown on Thursday only to be withdrawn.
runners.comment: Often highly tried; easy winner of a maiden last time; could be interesting

runners.name: Anushka
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner; good runs in 7f/1m handicaps at the Curragh this season but finished last there 40 days ago; even if back on song these terms aren't overly generous.
runners.comment: Even if back on song these terms aren't overly generous

runners.name: Benevento
runners.spotlight: Listed winner at two when based in Britain and ran okay on occasions when highly tried as a 3yo; below best in two runs since a gelding operation, the latest here on yard debut; ability respected but current wellbeing is an issue.
runners.comment: Below best in two runs since a gelding operation, the latest here on yard debut

runners.name: Felix Guido
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in three starts in Poland at up to 6.5f, making all each time; weakened badly to finish last in a 1m Naas handicap on stable debut in April; that was after 233 days off and now back from another break in a first-time tongue-tie; hard to assess.
runners.comment: Three wins in Poland over shorter; finished last in a 1m handicap on yard debut

runners.name: God Of Power
runners.spotlight: Three good runs since being gelded and the second to Tim Toe at Listowel now reads well; has less to prove than some of these.
runners.comment: Good runs since being gelded and the second to Tim Toe at Listowel now reads well

runners.name: Rahmi
runners.spotlight: The highest rated on official figures but has yet to produce a competitive effort this year and he needs a revival, even on these favourable terms; has been starting slowly.
runners.comment: These are favourable terms but has yet to produce an effort of note this year
runners.owner: Richard McNally & Leo Walsh & L Murrin

runners.name: Keep It Together
runners.spotlight: Poor hurdler and 200-1 when tailed off in a 1m4f maiden most recently; no appeal.
runners.comment: Poor hurdler and 200-1 when tailed off in a 1m4f maiden most recently; no appeal

races.race_name: 1XBET.IE COMMITMENT TO IRISH RACING (Ladies) Handicap

runners.name: Pahlavi
runners.spotlight: Regressive over hurdles lately and this Flat maiden hasn't run in this sphere for over three years; the cheekpieces are new.
runners.comment: Regressive over hurdles and Flat maiden hasn't run in this sphere for over three years

runners.name: Forthill
runners.spotlight: Interesting on last year's promise, placed in 1m3f/1m4f maidens; a bit underwhelming this campaign but still lightly raced and a visor is fitted for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Underwhelming this campaign but lightly raced and a visor is fitted for handicap debut

runners.name: Gatsby Grey
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler but has performed very moderately over fences since November last year and this is a belated return to the Flat with a new visor tried.
runners.comment: Useful hurdler but has performed very moderately over fences since November last year

runners.name: L'Un Deux Trois
runners.spotlight: The last of three Flat wins was three years ago and he's a limited jumper these days at the age of ten.
runners.comment: Last Flat win three years ago; a limited jumper these days at the age of ten

runners.name: Liberated Light
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap hurdle at Tramore before finishing fifth of 11 runners on return to Flat action back there a month ago (2m); ran okay that day and should be on the scene.
runners.comment: Running well over hurdles before his fifth of 11 back on the Flat

runners.name: Vervain
runners.spotlight: 2lb lower than for last summer's win at Cork (1m4f) and wasn't far away 23 days ago at Killarney (second run in tongue-tie); thereabouts.
runners.comment: 2lb lower than for last summer's win at Cork (1m4f) and wasn't far away 23 days ago

runners.name: Mapa
runners.spotlight: 22-race maiden but has placed form in handicaps and a maiden was no good last week; first-time hood.
runners.comment: 22-race maiden but has placed form in handicaps and a maiden was no good last week

runners.name: Anightaway
runners.spotlight: Only his eighth run when off the mark in good style at Sligo on Wednesday (1m5f, yielding), leaving behind his previous handicap efforts in a first-time tongue-tie; penalised accordingly but would have a big shout if turned out again.
runners.comment: Convincing winner over 1m5f at Sligo on Wednesday when in a first-time tongue-tie

runners.name: Numidia
runners.spotlight: Career wins number five and six last month when prevailing narrowly at Bellewstown (1m6f) and Down Royal (1m5f, good); has another 6lb rise to contend with but he's running well, unlike some in here.
runners.comment: Has another 6lb rise to contend with but he's running well, unlike some in here

runners.name: Ms Messi
runners.spotlight: Pretty poor in three runs since the 25-1 winner of a 1m4f Tipperary handicap 12 months ago; only 3lb higher if she was all the better for a break.
runners.comment: Only 3lb higher for last August's win if she was all the better for a break

runners.name: Monntie
runners.spotlight: Some promise in Flat maidens for previous yard and over hurdles for this one; tackles her first handicap here and could be competitive.
