runners.comment: Some promise in Flat maidens for previous yard and over hurdles for this one

races.race_name: Think Print & Design Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Penny Express
runners.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles; ran to a decent level last year, placing in three maiden hurdles over a range of trips on good ground; similar level when fourth at Listowel in May and shaped better than the bare result at Kilbeggan last month; okay C&D fourth last time; he's solid but vulnerable to improvers.
runners.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but okay runs in defeat; should run race but vulnerable to improvers

runners.name: Tomthescaffolder
runners.spotlight: Didn't trouble the judge in either bumper start; took fourth of 17 on hurdles debut at Clonmel (2m4f, good to yielding) in May; another decent effort over 2m4f here last time when a distant third; thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Fourth on hurdling bow and third over 2m4f here last time; thereabouts again

runners.name: Sea Eagle
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner was a good second of 15 on hurdles bow at Downpatrick in September (2m2f, yielding) and would have made the winner work for it if not unseating his rider at the last at Tramore in April (2m, soft); of concern is that the worst of his three hurdle runs came over C&D in October when a 21l sixth of 13 but could go well; well beaten on Flat when last seen.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner has posted some good efforts over hurdles; can go well

runners.name: Drumconnor Hill
runners.spotlight: Improved over his debut when making late gains to be beaten 17l into fourth at Ballinrobe in May (2m, good); didn't build on that over C&D last time when tailed off; a few questions arise after that performance.
runners.comment: Okay fourth on second hurdles start; questions arise after tailed off over C&D latest

runners.name: Run For Power
runners.spotlight: Weak in the market when down the field at Galway on bumper debut last September; much better at Killarney (2m1f, yielding) the following month when fourth of ten over hurdles; more needed all the same and absence to overcome too.
runners.comment: Fourth of ten over hurdles when last seen; more needed and returns from break

runners.name: Kingston Silver
runners.spotlight: Kingston Hill half-brother to winners Decision Time (1m4f/1m5f Flat, RPR 86; bumper/2m hurdle), Sergeant Wilson (bumper/2m hurdle) and Stucker Hill (2m5f/2m6f hurdle); dam 7f winner (92); market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to three winners; dam 7f winner; market best guide on debut

runners.name: Langage du Large
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to five winners including the useful Farceur Du Large; started the 5-2 favourite and was running respectably on point debut when falling last year; likely best watched unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Half-brother to five runners fell on point debut; best watched unless market speaks

runners.name: Storm Eric
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner is rated 54 on that surface; 0-19 on turf on Flat; makes hurdling bow with a good rider aboard but others more likely.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner is 0-19 on turf on Flat; others preferred on hurdling bow

runners.name: Earthwatch
runners.spotlight: Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas (1m, good); seems to be improving gradually over hurdles; holds top official rating in the field after taking fourth of 15 at Kilbeggan last time; in the mix.
runners.comment: Flat winner is improving gradually over hurdles and has top OR in field; in the mix

runners.name: Plastic Paddy
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner in Britain has struggled for new yard; has pulled up in all three runs over hurdles at huge odds; he would be a shock winner.
runners.comment: PU at huge prices in all three hurdle starts; he would be a shock winner

runners.name: Rosenborg
runners.spotlight: Decent third in sole completed point start; it was a weak maiden hurdle that he took second in at Sligo (2m2f, good) last time on his third run under rules but it was a positive effort nonetheless; may get involved with claimer now taking off 7lb.
runners.comment: Finished second in a weak maiden hurdle latest but it was still a positive effort

runners.name: You Lift Me Up
runners.spotlight: First reserve; well beaten on bumper debut at Killarney last month; hurdles need to bring out lumps of improvement from him.
runners.comment: Reserve; well beaten on bumper debut last month; hurdles need to bring big improvement

runners.name: Tell Me See
runners.spotlight: Never counted in a good-class Leopardstown bumper on debut; well beaten in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; unlikely.
runners.comment: Never counted on bumper debut nor switched to hurdles last time; unlikely

runners.name: Ribadora
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; not too bad in a Cork bumper in May but tailed off at Ballinrobe back over hurdles last time.
runners.comment: Reserve; not too bad in a bumper in May but tailed off back over hurdles latest

runners.name: Sum Story
runners.spotlight: No impact in either point-to-point and beaten 29l on rules debut at Downpatrick; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: No impact in either point and same story on rules bow; hard to fancy
runners.owner: J J Leckey & Donal P Keane & P J Rothwell

runners.name: Champagne Diamond
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in point-to-points and heavy defeat in sole start over hurdles at Cork a year ago; similar story likely.
runners.comment: 0-6 in points and took a heavy defeat in sole hurdles run last year; similar story likely

races.race_name: Treo Eile Mares Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Chosen Shant
runners.spotlight: Course specialist has bagged all three wins here (two over hurdles), including in this race last year off 2lb higher (good to yielding); fairly moderate form after that, but she has returned to form here over fences recently, winning a handicap chase (2m, good) and finishing second last time (2m, good); leading player.
runners.comment: Course specialist won this last year off 2lb higher and back to form over fences recently

runners.name: Avandra
runners.spotlight: 0-21 but some reasons for hope in her runs this season; was a 2l second at Tramore in May (2m, good) and okay efforts at Cork (2m2f, good) when fifth of 23 and when third of ten over C&D last time (good); more needed to win but definite place possibilities.
runners.comment: 0-21 but reasons for hope this season inc' when third over C&D last time; more needed

runners.name: Tropical Twist
runners.spotlight: Best hurdling effort came over C&D early last month when a 4.5l fifth (good), keeping on late in the game; a bit below that in a similar contest last time when a 10.5l fourth (3.25l behind Avandra); improvement required.
runners.comment: Ran best race over C&D last month but a bit below that last time; improvement needed

runners.name: Tellmemamema
runners.spotlight: Outran 80-1 odds at Down Royal (2m2f, good) on handicap debut in May when fourth of 20; a bit below that next time at Listowel (2m5f, good to yielding); midfield finish at Sligo last time (2m5f, good); cheekpieces go on now; place chance.
runners.comment: Outran 80-1 odds on h'cap debut when fourth; a bit below that twice since; place chance

runners.name: Annarubyrose
runners.spotlight: Decent handicap form for new yard; second on stable debut at Sligo in May (2m6f, good), fading late; fourth at Downpatrick (2m6f, good to yielding) later that month; okay fourth at Sligo last time (2m5f, good); drops in trip now but more needed to get home in front.
runners.comment: Decent handicap form for new yard; drops in trip now but more needed to win

runners.name: Backwithyourown
runners.spotlight: Fair form without winning, in bumpers and maiden hurdles; three handicaps have been less encouraging; tailed off at Clonmel in October; unseated at the first on C&D seasonal return here and tailed off at Kilbeggan last time (2m3f, good); others more likely.
runners.comment: Fair form in bumpers/m'dens; less encouraging form in three h'caps; tailed off latest

runners.name: Tudorista
runners.spotlight: Ran one of her best races on stable debut/second handicap start back from a break at Cork (2m4f, good) when keeping on steadily for fourth; always in rear when pulled up at Kilbeggan last time; tongue tie goes on after that disappointment and not ruled out if it has a positive effect.
runners.comment: Ran one of best races on stable debut back from break; tongue tie on after PU latest

runners.name: Stormy Jenn
runners.spotlight: Two wins on the Flat but 0-16 over hurdles; good effort when third of 24 at Navan in November (2m, heavy); pulled up next time at Fairyhouse; fell and tailed off in two runs this term so others have more persuasive recent form; declared for 6.20 at Sligo on Thursday.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner is 0-16 over hurdles and recent form is not persuasive

runners.name: Lady Victrix
runners.spotlight: Little impact in maidens and far too keen when tried in cheekpieces in last month's handicap debut at this track over 3m in cheekpieces (retained); declared for 6.20 at Sligo on Thursday.
runners.comment: Far too keen on h'cap debut here over 3m here last month; drops in trip

runners.name: Eaglewood
runners.spotlight: Best form has been at Tipperary, where she won a bumper and placed on her handicap debut in October; entitled to come on for recent comeback run at Cork.
runners.comment: Bumper winner's best form has been at Tipperary; entitled to come on for recent return

runners.name: Game Phoenix
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden on the Flat and over jumps (0-9 over hurdles); tailed off in both starts this season, the latest over fences; makes handicap hurdle debut now in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Reserve; Flat maiden is 0-9 over hurdles; tailed off in both runs this season; h'cap debut
runners.owner: Mrs B Power & John J Phelan

runners.name: Annie Agnew
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; juvenile hurdle winner in 2023 has run well in defeat at times since but well beaten in both starts this season; cheekpieces go on now.
runners.comment: Reserve; 2023 juvenile hurdle winner has been poor in both runs this term

runners.name: Wings Of Africa
runners.spotlight: Showed next to nothing in maidens; beaten a long way in both handicaps as well; hard to make a case for her.
runners.comment: Showed next to nothing in m'dens and beaten a long way in both h'caps too

runners.name: La Rocca Lass
runners.spotlight: Placed just once in seven bumpers; tailed off in all six starts over hurdles, the latest two in handicaps; tongue tie goes on.
runners.comment: Tailed off in all six starts over hurdles, the latest two in handicaps

runners.name: Teagarden Jazz
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden yet to show anything for current yard (formerly Gordon Elliott); tailed off over C&D back from a break last time; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Longstanding m'den yet to show anything for current yard; hard to fancy.

runners.name: Erne Star
runners.spotlight: No sign of winning potential in four starts in 2023; makes handicap debut now after over 2.5 years off the track.
runners.comment: No sign of winning potential in 2023 starts; h'cap debut after over 2.5 years off track
runners.owner: Mrs Peter Casey & Mrs Paula Casey

runners.name: Maxios Lady
runners.spotlight: First reserve; showed little in maidens and was pulled up on handicap debut when last seen at Listowel nearly a year ago.
runners.comment: Reserve; showed little in m'dens and PU on h'cap debut at Listowel over a year ago

races.race_name: Neville Hotels Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ma Belle Etoile
runners.spotlight: Won a Cork novice hurdle (2m2f, good) and a Wexford beginners' (2m, good) last summer; a fall over fences at Wexford is sandwiched between two okay efforts on the Flat this season; a tongue tie goes on for her handicap hurdle debut and she's race-fit but she's on a tough mark.
runners.comment: Hurdle/chase winner is race-fit but probably on a tough mark for her h'cap hurdle bow
runners.owner: P Haughey & P M Haughey & John Ball

runners.name: Shaboozee
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back winner at Ballinrobe in August last year at 2m1f/2m3f on good ground, the second of those by 14l; ran respectably in the Lartigue at Listowel (2m, good to yielding) off 1lb higher when last seen in September; appealing but this is his seasonal return.
runners.comment: Ran respectably off 1lb more in the Lartigue when last seen; makes seasonal return

runners.name: Splashing Out
runners.spotlight: Has lost her way until comfortably landing an eight-runner Tramore handicap in May (2m, good); given an easy lead that day and couldn't back it up at Galway when tailed off (2m1f, good); needs things to go her way.
runners.comment: Given an easy lead when winning Tramore h'cap; tailed off last time; needs things her way

runners.name: Mode Avion
runners.spotlight: French bumper winner has never raced on better than yielding to soft; made the breakthrough for his current stable when taking a six-runner Fairyhouse contest by 12l on handicap debut; came up short off revised mark in Listed handicaps at Fairyhouse and Punchestown towards end of last season; ground a concern for return.
runners.comment: Has struggled off new mark since easily winning on h'cap bow; may want softer

runners.name: Tassarolo
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a good third in a 1m4f Killarney Flat handicap last month but unable to back that up at Ballinrobe five days later; 2-6 hurdling although poor debut handicap effort at Cork when last seen in this discipline.
runners.comment: 2-6 hurdling but poor on h'cap debut; good Flat effort on penultimate

runners.name: Jabbar
runners.spotlight: Four-time Flat winner is 1-4 hurdling, with the victory coming in a Galway maiden hurdle in 2024; 9.25l fourth of eight over C&D (soft) when last seen over hurdles in March and hasn't been at his best in three Flat runs since then; others preferred.
runners.comment: Four-time Flat winner is 1-4 over hurdles but recent form is below his best

runners.name: Wonderfulwonderful
runners.spotlight: Won a Killarney maiden hurdle by 10l last August (2m1f, good); made all in a 1m1f Flat maiden last month in first-time cheekpieces at Ballinrobe in June; made her handicap hurdle debut at Galway last time (2m1f, good) when posting a disappointing performance; down 1lb but must bounce back.
runners.comment: M'den winner on Flat and over jumps; must bounce back from poor h'cap debut latest

runners.name: Now So Jake
runners.spotlight: Ready winner of a 2m Cork maiden hurdle in the summer of 2024 (good) but has been absent since well held in a Galway novice a month later; mammoth absence is a major blight on his prospects.
runners.comment: Ready m'den hurdle in 2024; mammoth absence is a major blight on his prospects

races.race_name: SIS Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Gerrys Wish
runners.spotlight: Went close at Perth and Galway over this trip last year before disappointing in her opening two runs this year; newly applied blinkers (retained) appeared to spark her back to life over C&D last time when 2.5l behind Set The Tone; 4lb better off with that rival now; chance.
runners.comment: 2.5l second behind Set The Tone over C&D last time and 4lb better off now; chance

runners.name: Clone Cross
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but chased home a 15l winner in a maiden over 2m4f here in May and faded into third after the last in a 2m5f Bellewstown handicap last month; got to within 4.25l of a 113-rated rival in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; mark is up 3lb for that, but he's consistent.
runners.comment: Running consistently and got to within 4.25l of a 113-rated rival in a maiden latest

runners.name: Mobile Mamma
runners.spotlight: Point winner has raced just four times over hurdles with little success; won a novice handicap chase for Ruth Jefferson at Newcastle in March last year (3m, good); made a positive stable debut over fences at Killarney last time when a 5l second of 15 over fences (2m7f, good to yielding); must bring that form to this sphere off a higher mark.
runners.comment: Point/h'cap chase winner must bring positive chase form to hurdles

runners.name: Charlie's Dilemma
runners.spotlight: 0-13 over hurdles but placed six times in maidens; no impact in initial handicap runs but fared better following the application of blinkers in his last two outings; 8l fourth at Limerick (2m7f, good) and 7.5l behind Set The Tone over C&D last time when keeping on well after getting squeezed for room at the third last; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Blinkers have gotten more from him; 7.5l behind Set The Tone latest; not ruled out

runners.name: Tango Theatre
runners.spotlight: 11yo is 1-27 over hurdles, the win coming at Sligo in August last year off 4lb higher (3m2f, good); okay fifth on seasonal return at Kilbeggan in June (3m1f, good to yielding) but was tailed off at Sligo last time (3m2f, good); others preferred.
runners.comment: 11yo is 1-27 over hurdles; tailed off last time; others preferred

runners.name: Clever Court
runners.spotlight: Pulled off a shock success at Bellewstown early last month (2m5f, good, 50-1) having pulled up in his previous four starts; moderate effort off 6lb higher over C&D last time.
runners.comment: Shock winner on penultimate after PU in previous four runs; moderate effort here latest

runners.name: Cruisin Susan
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps in 2024, the first of them was this race off 10lb higher (good) and at Tramore off 17lb higher (2m5f, good to yielding); lost her way badly following that but there were positive signs in her 3l third of 14 over C&D last time, staying on strongly; well handicapped if backing it up.
runners.comment: Signs of return to form over C&D latest; well treated if backing it up

runners.name: Set The Tone
runners.spotlight: Took a big step forward when second of 18 over an extended 2m6f at Limerick early last month (good); proved that was no fluke when winning over C&D last time (Gerrys Wish 2.25l behind in second); up 6lb but she's of obvious interest.
runners.comment: Found her form recently; up 6lb for winning over C&D latest but of obvious interest

runners.name: Sineads Fancy
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; sole win came at Downpatrick two years ago; down the field in three runs this season.
runners.comment: Reserve; sole win came two years ago; down the field in three runs this season

runners.name: Strong Contender
runners.spotlight: Little to shout about in maidens but ran better race switched to handicaps at Kilbeggan when a 10.5l seventh over this trip; midfield finish at Ballinrobe last time (2m6f, good); down 2lb more and place chance with 7lb claimer back aboard.
runners.comment: Okay effort on h'cap debut over this trip; place chance

runners.name: Mister Vic
runners.spotlight: Won a Ballinrobe handicap by 8l off 10lb lower last July; well beaten in three runs since so best watched for now.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three runs since winning last summer; best watched for now

runners.name: Fervida
runners.spotlight: No impact in six maiden hurdles and ran poorly on handicap debut at Bellewstown (2m5f, good); unseated at the first over C&D last time; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Hard to make a case for her after poor efforts in six maidens and two handicaps

runners.name: Fair Damsel
runners.spotlight: First reserve; won a 2m1f maiden at Killarney in 2024; fairly lightly raced since but recent form not that encouraging; loads more needed.
runners.comment: Reserve; won a 2m1f maiden in 2024; recent form not encouraging so loads more needed

runners.name: Matter Of Opinion
runners.spotlight: One of his better efforts came over 2m4f (good) here two weeks ago when a 10l seventh of 14; back up in trip now and down 2lb.
runners.comment: One of his better efforts came last time when seventh here; back up in trip now, down 2lb

runners.name: Glendine Billy
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden over hurdles; well beaten at Clonmel on seasonal return (2m1f, yielding); some improvement over 2m1f here (good) when a 5.25l eighth of 13; back up to 3m now.
runners.comment: 14-race maiden over hurdles; okay eighth here last time; back up to 3m now

runners.name: Joe's Turn
runners.spotlight: Got a first hurdles win at Kilbeggan in April last year off 6lb lower (3m1f, yielding); well beaten on return at Punchestown in May and didn't improve at Sligo (3m2f, good) last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Won off 6lb lower last year; well beaten in both starts this season; others preferred

runners.name: The Cobblers Wife
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; okay form at best in handicaps, lost action when pulled up at Punchestown last time; makes stable debut for new yard in a tongue tie now.
runners.comment: Reserve; just okay form in h'caps; PU when lost action latest; makes stable debut

races.race_name: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Bayonetta
runners.spotlight: Straight into handicap hurdles after a short spell in points; runner-up over this trip in a class 5 at Perth being her best effort; might have had a little too much use made of her at Downpatrick last time; headgear used that day left on here.
runners.comment: Runner-up over this trip in a class 5 at Perth her best effort; headgear left on today

runners.name: Hob's Angel
runners.spotlight: Fairly lightly raced overall; in very good form this year, winning a handicap hurdle at Clonmel in May and solid efforts since including over 3m here last time; drop back in trip is fine; handicapper has not been harsh on her and the jockey of the moment is booked to ride; ticks a lot of boxes
runners.comment: Won at Clonmel in May and solid efforts since including over 3m here last time; big player

runners.name: Itaintmebabe
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap at Fakenham last October over this trip but hasn't been near that level since including on debut for this yard; has to get back to his best but certainly not dismissed.
runners.comment: Has to get back to his best on his second start for Elliott but certainly not dismissed

runners.name: Deise Crystal
runners.spotlight: Poor effort on his handicap debut at Cork in April but much more like it in a pair of 2m1f handicap hurdles here in May; step up in trip is a slight question mark but looks a leading contender.
runners.comment: Two good runs here in May; step up in trip is a question mark but is a leading contender

runners.name: Jonny Carrol
runners.spotlight: Showed initial promise in maiden hurdles for Gordon Elliott in 2025; not totally disgraced in the first-time tongue-tie over C&D last month but more needed even in this company.
runners.comment: Not totally disgraced in the first-time tongue-tie over C&D last month but more needed

runners.name: Backinabit
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; transformed by blinkers when winning here 2m1f in July but not as good off this mark there since; headgear left off.
runners.comment: Third reserve; transformed by blinkers when winning here 2m1f in July; not as good latest

runners.name: Riverstown Boy
runners.spotlight: Has run to a similar level in three maiden hurdles from 2m to 3m on good ground; handicap mark probably fair enough on his handicap debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Handicap mark probably fair enough on his handicap debut; best watched

runners.name: Who's Da Goose
runners.spotlight: An unknown quantity after three unplaced efforts in 4yo maidens this summer; respected yard, worth a market check on handicap debut in a very winnable contest.
runners.comment: Respected yard, worth a market check on handicap debut in a veey winnablew contest

runners.name: Sekakarma
runners.spotlight: Had a long period on the sidelines but put in a couple of respectable efforts this summer in handicap hurdles at Punchestown and Downpatrick; trip is probably okay for him and good each-way claims.
runners.comment: Respectable efforts this summer in handicap hurdles at Punchestown and Downpatrick; claims

runners.name: Keep The Head
runners.spotlight: First reserve; nothing to recommend on all known form.
runners.comment: First reserve; nothing to recommend on all known form

runners.name: Barrogstown Girl
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner and improving over hurdles. culminating in a decent second in a 2m3f Kilbeggan contest two weeks ago; trip is suitable and unlikely to be too far away.
runners.comment: Second in a 2m3f Kilbeggan contest two weeks ago; trip is suitable and could go close

runners.name: Notmiwadi
runners.spotlight: Nothing obvious in three maiden hurdle runs last year; beaten out of sight after more than nine months off on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan last month; cheekpieces fitted here but very difficult to give a chance to.
runners.comment: Not mapped at Kilbeggan; cheekpieces fitted here but very difficult to give a chance to

runners.name: Zaryagle
runners.spotlight: Some promise in a Roscommon maiden hurdle a year ago; pulled up on his second start in a handicap at Limerick in October and not seen since; others much more likely.
runners.comment: Pulled up on his second start in a handicap at Limerick in October and not seen since

runners.name: John Dixen
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; showed some ability in a Limerick handicap hurdle in May but well beaten since.
runners.comment: Second reserve; showed ability in a Limerick handicap hurdle in May but well beaten since

runners.name: Charlie's Gift
runners.spotlight: Failed to complete twice since an okay run after a break at Clonmel in May; needs a step forward here.
runners.comment: Failed to complete twice since an okay run after a break at Clonmel in May; more needed

runners.name: Layenda
runners.spotlight: Had a subsequent triple winner behind her when a remore third in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle in May; cut no ice however on her handicap debut at the same venue the following month and may need to come down a little in the handicap.
runners.comment: Cut no ice however on her handicap debut at Downpatrick; may need to come down a little

runners.name: Madam Elle
runners.spotlight: Maiden and handicap form does not stack up to very much and easily passed over here.
runners.comment: Maiden and handicap form does not stack up to very much and easily passed over here

races.race_name: Pat Farrell Memorial Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Larkins Lane
runners.spotlight: Landed back-to-back successes over thid trip at Limerick and Sligo before anchored by weight increase at Sligo last month; early to write off and the trainer has decided to claim off her here.
runners.comment: Dual winner in May and June; anchored by penalties at Sligo last month; early to write off

runners.name: Las Brisas Boy
runners.spotlight: The step up to this trip on good ground might have been the key to a much improved effort when he was runner-up in a Sligo handicap last month; headgear is left on here and could well be on the upgrade.
runners.comment: Second in a Sligo handicap last month; headgear left on here and could be on the upgrade
runners.owner: Anthony Vaughan & Mark Phillips & D P Gaffney

runners.name: Poppycon
runners.spotlight: Seven race maiden but has taken very well to handicaps and acts on most ground; good second on his handicap debut here in March, and another fine effort over this trip with today's headgear when runner-up in a similar contest at Sligo last month; up 2lb for that effort and has plenty of weight but sets a standard that could see him home here.
runners.comment: Up 2lb for Sligo and has plenty of weight but sets a standard that could see him home here

runners.name: Davitts Quay
runners.spotlight: Reluctant to race here last month and way too keen on his return here three weeks later; looks far from straightforward and not exactly a betting proposition on what we know so far.
runners.comment: Looks far from straightforward and not really a betting proposition on what we know so far

runners.name: Ballinaboola Gold
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden over hurdles with her best finish being second iver 3m at Punchestown in May off 79;  below par since and drops back in trip here; can certainly get involved at her best.
runners.comment: Below par lately and drops back in trip here; can certainly get involved at her best

runners.name: Ballinvasas Best
runners.spotlight: Off the track for two years and caught the eye somewhat when fourth in a 2m1f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle last month; back up in trip here and interesting to see what the market makes of him.
runners.comment: Caught the eye when fourth in a 2m1f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle last month; interesting

runners.name: Esticky End
runners.spotlight: Has done most of his winning on the Flat in Britain, and has found a new lease of life over hurdles at his local track last month, following up a good second in a 2m1f handicap hurdle in early July by getting up on the line to land a similar handicap over the same trip three weeks later; up 6lb for those two efforts is far from excessive and he can be thereabouts once more with the step up in trip unlikely to be an issue.
runners.comment: Track winner can be thereabouts again with the step up in trip unlikely to ber an issue

runners.name: Dark Berkshire
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form until a much improved effort in a strongly run contest at Kilbeggan two weeks ago; could be a little more to come from him and rider bookings suggest he is the stable first-string.
runners.comment: Could be more to come from him and rider bookings suggest he is the stable first-string

runners.name: China Grill
runners.spotlight: Big odds and ran accordingly in three maidens and handicap hurdle; no obvious chance.
runners.comment: Big odds and ran accordingly in three maidens and handicap hurdle; no obvious chance

runners.name: Mother Ship
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden over hurdles; her Sligo third from last July off 3lb higher would give her a squeak, but well below that level since returning from a break, including over fences; more needed although the rider booking is a positive.
runners.comment: Well below her level since returning from a break, including over fences; more needed

runners.name: Little Boy Sivola
runners.spotlight: First reserve; pulled up at Kilbeggan last time after a reasonable Downpatrick run over further; fresh headgear combination reached for here.
runners.comment: First reserve; pulled up at Kilbeggan after a reasonable Downpatrick run over further

runners.name: Chosen Princess
runners.spotlight: Has shown a reasonable level of form in three maiden hurdle outings; might not be much wiggle room in her handicap mark but interesting on her debut in this sphere.
runners.comment: Might not be wiggle room in her handicap mark but interesting on her debut in this sphere

runners.name: Ballyminnion Boy
runners.spotlight: Maiden pointer soundly beaten at huge odds in three maiden hurdles; best watched in first handicap unless money comes for him.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten at huge odds in three maiden hurdles; best watched in first handicap

runners.name: Drumadeise
runners.spotlight: Showed little in maidens or on her handicap debut at Cork; easy to pass over here.
runners.comment: Showed little in maidens or on her handicap debut at Cork; easy to pass over here

runners.name: Laligurash
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; well beaten in three maiden hurdles and a handicap hurdle; much more required.
runners.comment: Second reserve; well beaten in three maiden hurdles and a handicap hurdle

runners.name: General Clermont
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; in decent form over fences last season but his record of 1 from 34 over hurdles, including Sligo Wednesday, tells its own story.
runners.comment: Third reserve; in decent form over fences last season but a record of 1-33 over hurdles

runners.name: Thurman
runners.spotlight: Showed a little in a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse in April but well beaten on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan later that month; would not appear well-handicapped on current evidence.
runners.comment: Well beaten on her handicap debut at Kilbeggan in April; needs to come down the handicap

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race

runners.name: Royal Tiara
runners.spotlight: Shorter trip and much better ground let to a much improved display from this mare when run out of it late in a Killarney bumper last month; tongue-tie tried here and should acquit herself well on a track that should suit.
runners.comment: Tongue-tie tried here and should acquit herself well on a track that should suit

runners.name: Shuil Solas
runners.spotlight: Clearly fancied on debut at Roscommon last month when having a lot of ground to make up; interesting that John Gleeson takes the mount on her rather than the Knockeen newcomer; big player potentially.
runners.comment: Interesting that John Gleeson takes the mount on her rather than the Knockeen newcomer

runners.name: Bredas Pearl
runners.spotlight: Decent effort when a fading third in a C&D bumper last month; likely to improve again but this looks somewhat tougher.
runners.comment: Third in a C&D bumper last month; likely to improve again but this looks somewhat tougher

runners.name: Vadique
runners.spotlight: Promise when an admittedly remote second on her debut at Listowel in May; failed to match that when hanging to her left at Cork last month; likely to appreciate going left-handed here but might find a couple too good in a strong-looking race.
runners.comment: likely to appreciate going left-handed here but might find a couple too good in this race

runners.name: Pat O's Rock
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to useful 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Beckett Rock; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, sister to useful bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Column Of Fire, half-sister to useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner Tully East; fine pedigree and the in-form yard had a debut bumper winner on Tuesday; regular stable amateur riding something else is worth pointing out however.
runners.comment: Very interesting debutant; eregular stable amateur riding something else however

runners.name: Slaney Valley
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam showed little Flat (RPR 35)/points, closely related to useful French winners Disclose (1m), World Ruler (7f/1m) and Grand Vista (5.5f/6f 2yo); Flat pedigree; hood being applied for her debut not really a positive sign; best watched.
runners.comment: Flat pedigree; hood being applied for her debut not really a positive sign; best watched

runners.name: Vartry Diamond
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Torquay Road (2m1f/2m2f hurdle) and Omaha Wish (2m chase); dam French 1m-1m4f winner (inc 2yo), half-sister to French 2m5f Listed hurdle winner El Gringo, out of French 1m5f/13.5f winner; useful pedigree; stable does not provide many debut bumper winners but worth watching for future reference; half-sister to today's rival Fully Functional.
runners.comment: Useful pedigree; stable does not provide many debut bumper winners but worth watching

runners.name: Fully Functional
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to today's rival Vartry Diamond; completed on the second of two point-to-points; best watched.
runners.comment: Completed on the second of two point-to-points; best watched

runners.name: Rathnaleen Aj
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to useful 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Kings Hill; dam unraced half-sister to winners Stick With Bill (useful 2m4f hurdle) and Conceroe (2m4f hurdle/2m5f chase), out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m-2m4f jump winner; stoutly bred daughter of Vadamos; likely to improve for time and a longer trip.
runners.comment: Stoutly bred daughter of Vadamos; likely to improve for time and a longer trip

runners.name: Baymount
runners.spotlight: Reappeared from a six month absence when pulled up after racing too keenly in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle two weeks ago; hard to fancy on her return to a bumper.
runners.comment: Too free in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle two weeks ago; hard to fancy on her return to bumper

runners.name: Hartes Angels
runners.spotlight: Stoutly-bred daughter of Wings Of Eagles; no show in a Kilbeggan bumper in June and hard to give a chance to here.
runners.comment: No show in a Kilbeggan bumper in June and hard to give a chance to here.

runners.name: Get It Girl
runners.spotlight: Very green on debut at Thurles in October, jumping the road twice and almost coming down; not seen since but sure to be more streetwise this time and is the likely favourite.
runners.comment: Not seen since October; sure to be more streetwise this time and is the likely favourite

races.race_name: Zyn Pole Position EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Ancestor
runners.spotlight: Improved on debut when winning a six-runner Yarmouth maiden last time (1m2f, good to firm; third has won since), pulling hard but getting the run of the race; obvious contender.
runners.comment: Off the mark in Yarmouth maiden last time (pulled hard); penalised but obvious contender

runners.name: Tropical Sands
runners.spotlight: Improved on debut run when 6.5l third to a stable companion of Ancestor in a Newbury novice last month (1m2f, good to soft); further improvement likely over this longer trip on better ground.
runners.comment: Improved on debut run when 6.5l third at Newbury last time; should improve for longer trip
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Golden Caviar
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two maidens, last week finishing nearly 10l fifth of eight at Wolverhampton (9.5f; 20-1); more needed.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two maidens (beaten nearly 10l on AW last week); more needed

races.race_name: Zyn In The Moment Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Clansman
runners.spotlight: Two wins on the AW (2m, 1m4f) earlier in the year, although well beaten in the Northumberland Plate consolation race last time (2m); turf wins have all come on soft/heavy ground so needs rain.
runners.comment: Two AW wins earlier this year (below-par latest); all turf wins on soft/heavy; needs rain
runners.owner: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Dream Harder
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ian Williams; first win for current yard with first-time tongue-tie at Epsom last week (1m4f, good to firm), quickening up well after not getting best of runs; could go well with a 4lb penalty although below par two previous runs at 1m6f.
runners.comment: Ex-Ian Williams; 1m4f winner at Epsom last week; could go well, but longer trip a concern

runners.name: Fast Fred
runners.spotlight: Winner off 4lb lower at Musselburgh in April (1m4f, good) and back to form when runner-up at Chester last time (1m4f, good); seems to stay 1m6f so could go well.
runners.comment: Musselburgh winner in April, and sound run when 2nd at Chester last time; should go well

runners.name: Made All
runners.spotlight: Set plenty to do in a muddling race for amateurs when third at 8-15 at Catterick on latest Flat start (1m4f, good to firm); bit below-par over hurdles last time; first try at 1m6f.
runners.comment: Slightly unlucky third on latest Flat start (1m4f); this stronger; first try at 1m6f

runners.name: Havachoc
runners.spotlight: Three wins on the AW earlier this year (1m4f); some fair form since, best turf runs being when placed over 1m4f at Beverley; stays 1m6f; a possible.
runners.comment: Three 1m4f AW wins earlier this year; some fair form on turf since; stays 1m6f; a possible

runners.name: Caph Star
runners.spotlight: Two good runs when third at York and second at Newbury (both over 10.5f) for today's rider on last two starts; interesting, although stamina not guaranteed on first run at beyond 1m3f.
runners.comment: Two good placed runs on last 2 starts (10.5f); could go well on first run at beyond 1m3f.

runners.name: Arrange
runners.spotlight: Won a valuable 2m handicap here in August 2024 (good); hasn't won since, but comes into this in good form (second over 2m on last two starts, with cheekpieces back on last time); no cheekpieces here but on a good mark and one with a chance.
runners.comment: 2m winner here in 2024; close second over 2m on last two starts and one with a chance
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Edward Sexton
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; good bumper performer (two places before 1m5f Fontwell win in March 2025); fair runs at up to 1m4f on the AW on the Flat so far, beaten 10l by Constitution Hill over 1m4f at Kempton in March; chance back up in trip on second handicap start.
runners.comment: Decent form in bumpers; modest form on AW on the Flat; chance up in trip back on turf

races.race_name: Zyn Pacesetter Cup Nursery Handicap

runners.name: God Given Talent
runners.spotlight: Created a good impression when winning on his debut at Newbury (6f, good) in May; well beaten in the Coventry Stakes next time but didn't run badly in a Listed event back at Newbury three weeks ago; has since left James Ferguson and drops to 5f for his stable/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Newbury debut winner (6f) and ran okay in a Listed race there latest; makes his yard debut

runners.name: Undercover Affair
runners.spotlight: Two wins from ten starts, with one of those successes coming when beating Jaijai in a three-runner nursery at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last month; didn't prove up to it in the Molecomb last week but should be competitive back into a handicap.
runners.comment: 2-10; beat Jaijai in a nursery at Windsor last month; well held in the Molecomb last week

runners.name: Rotelle
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Nottingham (5f, good) in April and he was subsequently gelded; off for 108 days before finishing midfield in a Newcastle novice (6f) two weeks ago and now drops back to 5f for his nursery debut; watch the betting.
runners.comment: Gelded after his winning debut at Nottingham; midfield in a 6f Newcastle novice latest

runners.name: Jaijai
runners.spotlight: Made all in a maiden at Goodwood (5f, good; runner-up has won since) in June but he raced too freely over 6f in a competitive race there a week ago and was beaten by Undercover Affair in a three-runner contest at Windsor last month ; better is needed but this drop back in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Won a 5f maiden in June; too free in a competitive race at Goodwood last week; back to 5f

runners.name: Casino Star
runners.spotlight: Bumped into the subsequent Coventry third on his debut at Hamilton (6f, good to soft) in June but failed to build on that at York (6f) next time; however, he ran well when beaten a neck by the subsequent Molecomb third back at Hamilton (5f) last month; commands major respect on his nursery debut.
runners.comment: Ran well when beaten a neck by the subsequent Molecomb third at Hamilton; respected

runners.name: Dance A Jig
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Brocklesby on his debut and was beaten only a neck by Adaay Of Scarlett, who has since finished second in a trio of Group 2 events, at Ascot (5f, good to firm); struggled in the Windsor Castle (6f) in June and drops back in trip on his nursery debut having been off since; has claims.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 5f on first two starts but struggled in the Windsor Castle; nursery debut

races.race_name: Zyn Frontrunner Finish EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Arthurian
runners.spotlight: 8-1, kept on under hands and heels into 3l sixth of 12 on debut in a warm novice at Newbury (7f, good to firm) last month; that was a promising start for this Camelot colt, who should be suited by the step up to 1m; player.
runners.comment: Promising 6th on debut in warm novice at Newbury and should be suited by the step up to 1m

runners.name: Burning Up
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; Too Darn Hot half-brother to connections' 7f 2yo/1m4f Listed winner Novakai; dam 1m4f-1m6f winner (98), half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Elas Ruby; represents powerful 2yo stable and could play a leading role on debut, especially if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Half-brother to connections' 7f 2yo/1m4f Listed winner Novakai; could play leading role
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Golden Falcon
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam unraced sister to winners Platinum Warrior (US 1m2f Grade 2) and Hadrianus (Listed-placed 1m3f 2yo), out of 1m Group 2 winner; stable has very healthy 25% strike-rate with 2yos in the last five seasons; this Space Blues newcomer is one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Unraced dam from classy family; trainer 25% strike-rate with 2yos in the last five seasons

runners.name: King Kenny
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; ninth foal; Space Traveller half-brother to winners including San Carlos (7f AW including 2yo; RPR 88) and Signora Camacho (5f/6f 2yo; 83); dam 7f AW 2yo winner (77), half-sister to 5f/5.5f Group 2 winner Signora Caballo; trainer much better known for exploits with older horses.
runners.comment: Half-brother to three winners; trainer much better known for exploits with older horses

runners.name: Skylar
runners.spotlight: 58,000euros yearling; fifth foal; closely related to 1m AW winner Si Grass (RPR 82), half-brother to winners including Sirona (7f-1m including 2yo/Listed); dam 1m-10.5f winner (including French Group 3); this Australia newcomer could give a good account but a useful standard will be needed.
runners.comment: 58,000euros yearling; could give a good account on debut but a useful standard is needed

runners.name: Parry Green
runners.spotlight: 250-1 on both starts and has failed to beat a rival each time.
runners.comment: 250-1 on both starts and has failed to beat a rival each time

races.race_name: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Aphra Behn
runners.spotlight: Promising third on debut at Salisbury (6f, soft) and short-headed at Newcastle (7f, AW) next time; turned over at odds-on at Lingfield (7f, AW) last time, when a close fourth; some of these probably have greater potential but she might not be far away.
runners.comment: 0-3 and some of these probably have greater potential but she might not be far away

runners.name: Silver Sovereign
runners.spotlight: Best of the rest behind the 2-7 favourite on debut in five-runner novice at Salisbury last month (6f, good to firm; 13-2); the third has won in fine style since and she's from a family her owner has done very well with; open to improvement and she's a leading contender.
runners.comment: Second to 2-7 favourite on debut at Salisbury and the third has won since; leading claims

runners.name: Remember The Show
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Showcasing half-sister to winners Elements Of Fire (7f AW including 2yo; RPR 99) and Forgotten Treasure (7f; 62); dam 7f 2yo winner (97); one to watch in the betting but she's likely to improve for this debut outing.
runners.comment: 50,000gns half-sister to 2 winners; watch betting but likely to improve for this debut run

runners.name: Syndicale
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to four-time Group 1 winner Ombudsman who was sent off at 1-2 when winning by half a length on last month's debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW); the runner-up is now 0-5 but she could have lots more to offer and has a Group 1 entry; very much respected under a 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Ombudsman who won at odds of 1-2 on last month's debut at Wolverhampton

runners.name: Sea Angie Run
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Ghaiyyath half-sister to winners Celtic Warrior (7f-1m3f; RPR 88), Gentle Whinny (1m 2yo; 75) and Tearaway Two (Danish 7f/Norwegian 8.7f); dam 5f 2yo winner (80), half-sister to 1m2f 2yo Group 1 winner Wonderment; may be best watched in a useful race on debut.
runners.comment: 40,000gns half-sister to three winners; may be best watched in a useful race on debut

runners.name: Scrappetalene
runners.spotlight: 48,000gns yearling; ninth foal; Camelot half-sister to five winners notably Nemean Lion (Group-placed 1m4f Flat; smart 1m7f-2m4f hurdle) and No More Bolero (1m2f-2m1f Flat including 2yo, RPR 99; 2m hurdle); dam Listed-placed 1m1f winner (93); she may need further than this debut trip.
runners.comment: Camelot half-sister to five winners but she may need further than this debut trip

runners.name: Tradittion
runners.spotlight: There's some potential in her pedigree and she could be sharper for last month's seventh of ten on debut at Catterick (7f, good to firm), where she was slowly away at 18-1; however, this is a hotter race and considerable improvement is necessary.
runners.comment: Could be sharper for last month's debut seventh but considerable improvement is necessary

runners.name: Freshwater
runners.spotlight: Beaten 8l when fifth on recent debut at Catterick (7f, good to firm) but this Cheveley Park filly was sent off at just 2-1 and was scuppered by being hampered early; interesting to see if she's again strong in the betting.
runners.comment: Only fifth on debut at Catterick but sent off 2-1 and was hampered early; interesting

runners.name: Expensive Luxury
runners.spotlight: Her dam was a German Listed winner but she was well beaten at 20-1 on debut at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) three weeks ago and her stable has much stronger claims with previous winner Syndicale.
runners.comment: Dam was a German Listed winner but she was well beaten at 20-1 on debut at Wolverhampton

races.race_name: Find Your Zyn Moment Stride Handicap

runners.name: Tokyo Joe
runners.spotlight: Kicked off campaign with two good runs in competitive Class 4 handicaps (6f/7f, good to firm/good) and he capitalised on the drop back in grade to win at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month despite hanging badly left; the placed horses have both won since and he's gone up just 1lb; key player.
runners.comment: Won at Ffos Las last month despite hanging badly left; placed horses have both won since

runners.name: Farandaway
runners.spotlight: It took him a long time to win but he landed a maiden at Newcastle (6f, AW) in March and was back on the scoresheet at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) last month; good second at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) since; solid claims.
runners.comment: Won at Thirsk last month and good second at Doncaster since; solid claims

runners.name: Distinct Spirit
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 6yo who won a four-runner handicap at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month and followed up in three-runner handicap at Lingfield (7.6f, good to firm) last Saturday; carries 5lb penalty in a much deeper race today but he did it comfortably last time; clearly thriving; respected.
runners.comment: This is much deeper than the races he won on his last two starts but he's still respected

runners.name: Invincible Ruby
runners.spotlight: Two 6f wins at Carlisle this summer (good) and close second of 18 at York (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; this bang-in-form filly could play another leading role.
runners.comment: 2 wins this summer and close 2nd of 18 at York last time; could play another leading role

runners.name: Magic Music
runners.spotlight: Third at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) in May and won there (7f, good to firm) in June; soundly beaten sixth of seven there (7f, good to firm) last time; this lightly raced 4yo is not written off but needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Won at Doncaster in June; well beaten there since; not written off but has to bounce back

runners.name: Potomac River
runners.spotlight: Last of six at Epsom (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago but he's shown glimpses of significant promise in his short career and is worth a second look in view of the excellent form of his stable.
runners.comment: Finished last at Epsom but still lightly raced and stable is in excellent form

runners.name: Bajan Bandit
runners.spotlight: He's run pretty well in this visor on his last two starts, last time 3l second of 12 at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW); however, he's back up into a 0-75 here and has won just one of his last 29 races; may again be vulnerable.
runners.comment: He's run pretty well in this visor of late but has won just one of his last 29 races

runners.name: Criminal Shore
runners.spotlight: Won on turf last April and snapped long losing run at Newcastle (1m, AW) in June; however, well beaten back on turf on his last two starts and he needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Won at Newcastle (1m, AW) in June but well beaten back on turf on his last two starts

runners.name: Evocative Spark
runners.spotlight: Three wins at Catterick this spring (7f/6f, good); reportedly never travelling when below par there at the end of May and has had a break since; runner-up here in 2024 on sole previous Haydock visit; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Three wins at Catterick this spring; break since below-par latest run there; not ruled out

runners.name: Montezin
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has run some encouraging races in handicaps this year; made good headway before run petered out when fifth of 15 at York (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago and he could benefit from today's drop back in trip and grade; possible player.
runners.comment: Headway before run petered out at York; could benefit from the drop back in trip/grade

runners.name: Raffles Angel
runners.spotlight: Came from the back of the field to win here (6f, good) last July and she's been a good third on her last two starts (6f, good/good to firm); kept on well at Newbury last time and now has a belated second crack at 7f, which is well worth a go; she's one to consider.
runners.comment: 6f course winner for whom this belated second crack at 7f is well worth a go; considered

races.race_name: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Newcomers' "Confined" Maiden Stakes (For Horses Which Have Never Run) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Desert Castle
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt who is a sibling to five winners, notably Dream Castle (7f-1m1f including UAE Group 1; RPR 116) and With The Moonlight (1m-1m2f including 2yo/UAE Group 2; 115); dam 5f/6f 2yo scorer (including Group 2; 111); holds two Group entries; yard has won this contest three times this decade; respected.
runners.comment: Frankel colt whose siblings include a Group 1 winner; holds two Group entries; respected

runners.name: Hierax
runners.spotlight: 425,000gns yearling; Frankel half-brother to three winners, notably Dramatised (5f including 2yo/Group 2; RPR 113); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo scorer (107), out of half-sister to French 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Aquatinta; has the biggest price tag among the runners who went through the sales ring; one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: 425,000gns yearling; Frankel half-brother to three winners; one for the shortlist

runners.name: Farasan
runners.spotlight: Teofilo colt who is a sibling to two winners, notably his connections' Oxagon (7f/1m including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 110); dam 6f AW 2yo scorer (75), out of Italian 1m Group 3 winner; one to bear in mind, especially if the market speaks favourably.
runners.comment: Sibling includes his connections' 2yo/Group 3 scorer Oxagon; one to bear in mind

runners.name: My Boy
runners.spotlight: 110,000euros yearling; brother to German/French Group-placed 7f-1m4f winner Nasomo (including 2yo; RPR 94); dam 1m2f scorer (including Group 3; 108), closely related to two German 1m4f Group 1 winners; check the betting.
runners.comment: 110,000euros yearling; brother to a useful performer on the continent

runners.name: Sommood
runners.spotlight: 380,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Kingman and first foal of 7f-1m7f scorer (including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 114) who is half-sister to winners Gallante (1m4f/2m Group 1) and Party House (Group-placed 1m2f); stable is operating at an impressive strike-rate (11-23) with 2yos this season; very interesting.
runners.comment: 380,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Kingman; yard is 11-23 with 2yos this term; interesting

runners.name: Re Shardana
runners.spotlight: Colt by Victor Ludorum out of unraced sibling to winners Raphael (1m) and Roxette (7f); wears tongue-tie; the least appealing contender.
runners.comment: Victor Ludorum colt who is the least appealing contender

runners.name: Nidal
runners.spotlight: Colt by Mayson and first foal of unraced half-sister to winners Catan (useful 6f-1m) and Coupe De Champagne (9.4f-1m4f) and daughter of German 1m2f scorer; less interesting than most of his rivals.
runners.comment: Mayson colt who looks less interesting than most of his rivals

runners.name: Netherstream
runners.spotlight: 37,000gns foal, 100,000euros yearling; by Pinatubo; dam French Group-placed 1m2f/1m3f winner (RPR 101), half-sister to useful 7f-1m1f scorer Climate Change, is granddaughter of French 10.5f Listed winner; market may prove best guide.
runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling; by Pinatubo; market may prove best guide

races.race_name: Zyn Pole Position Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Zarakova
runners.spotlight: Both starts in small fields, finishing last at Wolverhampton (AW) then faring much better with close second at Epsom (7f, good to firm; made the running); sets the form standard and looks open to further progress.
runners.comment: Close second at Epsom last time; sets the form standard and is open to further progress

runners.name: Oh Sweet Adare
runners.spotlight: 900,000gns yearling; by Starspangledbanner; sibling to three winners, notably Avicenna (7f 2yo including Listed; RPR 105); dam 1m AW 2yo scorer (94), sister to 1m Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner Boherbuoy; powerful stable; interesting debutante.
runners.comment: 900,000gns yearling; siblings include a Listed winner; powerful stable; interesting

runners.name: Lily Pink
runners.spotlight: Cracksman filly who is a sibling to three winners, notably Masai Moon (1m AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 97); dam unraced sister to 1m4f Group 3 scorer Royal Line, out of half-sister to Galileo; one of two newcomers in the field; check the betting.
runners.comment: Cracksman filly; one of two newcomers in the field; check the betting
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Bint Palace Pier
runners.spotlight: Recorded only a modest RPR in finishing seventh of eight at Sandown but perhaps found the minimum trip much too sharp; bred to be suited by this extra 3f and may show improvement.
runners.comment: Perhaps found 5f much too sharp on debut; may show improvement upped in trip

races.race_name: Carling Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Nabati
runners.spotlight: Holds two Group entries; both starts over 6f on good to firm ground, comfortably landing the odds at Yarmouth then running well (neck second to unbeaten rival) when joint-favourite for Listed event at Newbury; sets a useful standard back down in class.
runners.comment: Won comfortably at Yarmouth then ran well in Newbury Listed race; sets a useful standard

runners.name: Al Widyan
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns foal; by Havana Grey and first foal of unraced half-sister to winners Shifachi (useful HK 6f) and Rosay (1m 2yo Listed) and daughter of 6f 2yo/1m Listed scorer; will need to be a useful newcomer to trouble the main form contenders.
runners.comment: 50,000gns foal; will need to be a useful newcomer to trouble the main form players

runners.name: Tawakal
runners.spotlight: Holds three Group entries; 325,000euros breeze-up buy who showed signs of greenness en route to justifying favouritism in Nottingham maiden (6f, good to firm), contributing to his yard's excellent strike-rate with 2yos this term; open to progress and warrants respect.
runners.comment: 325,000euros breeze-up buy; justified favouritism in Nottingham maiden; open to progress

runners.name: Roll Up Raymond
runners.spotlight: 26,000gns foal, £14,000 yearling, £16,500 (breeze-up) 2yo; Showcasing half-brother to two winners, notably Italica (6f 2yo; RPR 89); dam US 1m turf scorer (including 2yo stakes); faces a demanding assignment on debut.
runners.comment: £16,500 (breeze-up) 2yo; faces a demanding assignment on debut

runners.name: The Resdev Rocket
runners.spotlight: Has recorded only modest RPRs in a couple of 7f events; falls well short of the required standard dropped in distance and is likely to be more interesting in nurseries soon.
runners.comment: Modest RPRs in 7f events; falls well short of the required standard

races.race_name: Molson Coors Beverage Company Handicap

runners.name: Fiscal Policy
runners.spotlight: Returns to rather calmer waters after coming up well short in bigger fields at York last month; in particularly good form in June, winning at Pontefract then placed twice over C&D; could go well.
runners.comment: Returns to rather calmer waters; placed twice over C&D in June; could go well
runners.owner: S Thompson, Mrs R Carr & G Shields

runners.name: Fenlander
runners.spotlight: Close third to Spring Bloom over C&D last week when bidding for a four-timer after wins elsewhere (maiden previously); still on career-high mark but, by the same token, remains in good form; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Close third to Spring Bloom over C&D last week when bidding for a four-timer; in the mix

runners.name: Royal Accord
runners.spotlight: Gained most recent win over C&D last August when with Stuart Williams; however, brings a doubt over current form, having trailed home last (eased once held) in big field at York on stable/seasonal debut.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last August; trailed home last at York on stable/seasonal debut

runners.name: Havana Blue
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 7f; on a two-year losing spell but his turn looks near, having finished second at Ascot (good to firm) the last twice; successful on both Newmarket tracks and the way he races suggests this drop back to 6f is worth exploring; respected.
runners.comment: On a two-year losing spell but last two efforts suggest his turn is near; course winner

runners.name: The Caltonian
runners.spotlight: Multiple AW winner; has shown most of his turf form at Ayr, not disgraced last time; 0-22 in this sphere, so the booking of Oisin Murphy (up for first time) needs to make a significant difference.
runners.comment: 0-22 on turf, so the booking of Oisin Murphy needs to make a significant difference
runners.owner: John Murphy & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Akabusi
runners.spotlight: By no means certain to give his running, having proved inconsistent for current yard; however, won off 1lb higher on the other Newmarket course in May and has a fighting chance on that form.
runners.comment: Inconsistent for current yard but has a fighting chance on form of Newmarket win in May

runners.name: Aspull
runners.spotlight: Solid record at novice level has not been sustained in handicaps; sold out of Clive Cox's yard for £1,000 since last run; may benefit from the drop to sprinting, having been too free in both starts this term.
runners.comment: Solid record at novice level has not been transferred to handicaps; stable debut

runners.name: Spring Bloom
runners.spotlight: Retains plenty of vitality aged nine; record over C&D features wins in this race two years ago and in his last two starts, latest by a neck seven days ago; rock-solid kept to this scenario and likely to remain competitive even with 4lb penalty.
runners.comment: Record over C&D features wins in this race two years ago and in last two starts; solid

runners.name: Fifty Nifty
runners.spotlight: On a two-year losing spell and isn't totally solid on 2026 efforts but the latest is best forgiven (got no sort of run; second start for new yard); attractively treated on best form and is a course winner.
runners.comment: Latest effort is best forgiven; attractively treated on best form and is a course winner

runners.name: Lil Brother
runners.spotlight: Dual winner on turf for previous yard; absent and had wind/gelding operations since below-par effort on AW last December (stable debut); the market signals may give useful extra guidance on reappearance.
runners.comment: Absent and had wind/gelding operations since below-par effort on AW last December

races.race_name: Rekorderlig Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Lexington Express
runners.spotlight: Successful three times over 1m-9.5f on AW this year; failed to transfer the pick of that form back to turf last time; 0-8 in this sphere and has enough to prove dropped back to 7f.
runners.comment: Failed to transfer the pick of her AW form back to turf last time

runners.name: Show Me Gold
runners.spotlight: Raced only five times, mostly on AW; scored on handicap debut but failed to back up that form latest start; modest effort in sole turf attempt, albeit on ground that was possibly too soft.
runners.comment: AW winner; modest effort in sole turf attempt, albeit on soft ground

runners.name: Albeseeingyer
runners.spotlight: Losing run is mounting up but she ran respectably at Carlisle most recently; form over C&D comprises a ready win (off 2lb higher) in this contest two years ago and creditable third (off 7lb higher) last August; good chance back here.
runners.comment: Form over C&D includes a win off 2lb higher in this race two years ago; good chance

runners.name: Hilltop
runners.spotlight: Consistent record this term features an AW success; ran respectably, despite a tardy start, on the turf course at Lingfield most recently; remains on career-high mark but has a solid chance.
runners.comment: Consistent this term; remains on career-high mark but has a solid chance

runners.name: Rogue Citation
runners.spotlight: Raced only four times and may do better still; scored on AW as a 2yo and ran well, with tongue-tie fitted, in Catterick handicap (7f, good to firm) most recently; possibilities off same mark.
runners.comment: Ran well at Catterick last time and may do better still; possibilities

runners.name: Areti
runners.spotlight: Probably didn't need to improve to win Redcar novice event (7f, good to firm) last week, opening her account at the ninth attempt; however, has proved largely consistent and should go well.
runners.comment: Off the mark in Redcar novice event last week; has proved largely consistent

runners.name: Melodical
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress in three starts over 6f last term but showed ability all the same, twice giving the impression this extra furlong will suit on handicap/seasonal debut; market support would heighten interest.
runners.comment: Open to improvement upped to 7f on handicap/seasonal debut

runners.name: Lucky Hero
runners.spotlight: Had been looking exposed until upped to this trip (ran right away with a Redcar handicap nine days ago); no penalty for that apprentice-race win and will be fully 9lb higher from tomorrow, so his claims are obvious.
runners.comment: Easy win at Redcar nine days ago; will be 9lb higher from tomorrow; his claims are obvious

runners.name: Blue Noon
runners.spotlight: Has been running respectably in handicaps against her own age group this summer, without looking to have anything in hand, and is starting to look exposed now; needs to find more against two in-form rivals.
runners.comment: Starting to look exposed now; needs to find more against two in-form rivals

runners.name: Shimmering Sands
runners.spotlight: All five victories have come over a stiff 1m2f so he has that in his favour, including two round Pontefract in June; never won off a mark this high, though, and an 8lb rise for a wide-margin success in an amateurs' handicap last time will test him.
runners.comment: 8lb rise for a wide-margin success last time will test him (never won off this high)
